title.zh: 卷七十五 志第五十一 職官四
title.raw: 卷七十五 志第五十一 職官四 Volume 75 Treatises 51: Official Posts 4

sentences.zh: 南京宗人府吏部戶部附總督糧儲禮部兵部刑部工部都察院附提督操江通政司大理寺詹事府翰林院國子監太常寺光祿寺太僕寺鴻臚寺尚寶司六科行人司欽天監太醫院五城兵馬司應天府附上元江寧二縣已上南京官王府長史司布政司按察司各道行太僕寺苑馬寺都轉運鹽使司鹽課提舉司市舶提舉司茶馬司府州縣儒學巡檢司驛稅課司倉庫織染局河泊所附閘壩官批驗所遞運所鐵冶所醫學陰陽學僧綱司道紀司

translations.literal: Nanjing Court of the Imperial Clan, Ministry of Personnel, Ministry of Revenue with appended Supervisor of Grain Storage, Ministry of Rites, Ministry of War, Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Works, Censorate with appended Supervisor of River Training, Office of Transmission, Court of Judicial Review, Household of the Heir Apparent, Hanlin Academy, Directorate of Education, Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Court of Imperial Entertainments, Court of the Imperial Stud, Court of State Ceremonial, Imperial Seals Office, Six Offices of Scrutiny, Reception Office, Directorate of Astronomy, Imperial Medical Institute, Five-City Military Patrol Office, Yingtian Prefecture with appended Shangyuan and Jiangning counties—the above are Nanjing offices; Princely Chief Steward Offices, Provincial Administration Commissions, Provincial Surveillance Commissions, circuit offices, traveling Office of the Imperial Stud, Stud Farms, Salt Transport Commissions, Salt Tax Offices, Maritime Trade Offices, Tea and Horse Offices, prefectures, departments, counties, Confucian schools, inspection posts, courier stations, tax offices, warehouses, dyeing offices, river fisheries offices with appended sluice and dam officials, inspection and verification offices, relay transport offices, ironworks, medical schools, schools of Yin-Yang, Buddhist registry offices, Taoist registry offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanjing Court of the Imperial Clan; the Ministry of Personnel; the Ministry of Revenue (with appended Supervisor of Grain Storage); the Ministry of Rites; the Ministry of War; the Ministry of Justice; the Ministry of Works; the Censorate (with appended Supervisor of River Training); the Office of Transmission; the Court of Judicial Review; the Household of the Heir Apparent; the Hanlin Academy; the Directorate of Education; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; the Court of Imperial Entertainments; the Court of the Imperial Stud; the Court of State Ceremonial; the Imperial Seals Office; the Six Offices of Scrutiny; the Reception Office; the Directorate of Astronomy; the Imperial Medical Institute; the Five-City Military Patrol Office; Yingtian Prefecture (with Shangyuan and Jiangning counties)—the above are Nanjing offices; princely chief steward offices; provincial administration commissions; provincial surveillance commissions; circuit offices; traveling offices of the imperial stud; stud farms; salt transport commissions; salt tax offices; maritime trade offices; tea and horse offices; prefectures, departments, and counties; Confucian schools; inspection posts; courier stations; tax offices; warehouses; dyeing offices; river fisheries offices (with sluice and dam officials); inspection and verification offices; relay transport offices; ironworks; medical schools; schools of yin-yang; Buddhist registry offices; and Taoist registry offices.

sentences.zh: 南京宗人府。

translations.literal: Nanjing Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanjing Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 經歷司，經歷一人。

translations.literal: Registry, one Registrar.
translations.idiomatic: A Registry with one Registrar.

sentences.zh: 南京官品秩，俱同北京。

translations.literal: Nanjing official ranks and grades were all the same as at Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: Official ranks and grades at Nanjing were identical to those at Beijing.

sentences.zh: 吏部。

translations.literal: Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 尚書一人，右侍郎一人。

translations.literal: One Minister, one Right Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister and one Right Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 六部侍郎，至弘治後始專設右。

translations.literal: For vice ministers of the Six Ministries, right-hand posts were established only after the Hongzhi reign.
translations.idiomatic: Right-hand vice minister posts in the Six Ministries were not established until after the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 萬曆三年俱革。

translations.literal: In the third year of Wanli all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli year 3 (1575) all were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一年復設。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year they were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 (1583) they were restored.

sentences.zh: 天啟中，每部增侍郎一人。

translations.literal: During the Tianqi period, each ministry gained an additional vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tianqi emperor each ministry gained an extra vice minister.

sentences.zh: 崇禎間革。

translations.literal: During the Chongzhen period they were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Under Chongzhen they were abolished again.

sentences.zh: 其屬，司務廳，司務一人。

translations.literal: Subordinate offices: Clerks Office, one Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate offices included a Clerks Office with one Clerk.

sentences.zh: 文選、考功、驗封、稽勳四清吏司，各郎中一人，主事一人。

translations.literal: Four Pure Officials Bureaus—Personnel Selection, Merit Evaluation, Seal Verification, and Merit Records—each with one Bureau Director and one Section Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Four Pure Officials Bureaus—Personnel Selection, Merit Evaluation, Seal Verification, and Merit Records—each had one Bureau Director and one Section Chief.

sentences.zh: 驗封、稽勳二司主事，後並革。

translations.literal: The section chiefs of the Seal Verification and Merit Records Bureaus were later both abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The section chiefs of the Seal Verification and Merit Records Bureaus were later abolished.

sentences.zh: 凡南京官，六年考察，考功掌之，不由北吏部。

translations.literal: For all Nanjing officials, triennial evaluations at six-year intervals were conducted, supervised by the Merit Evaluation Bureau, not by the northern Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: All Nanjing officials underwent six-year merit evaluations supervised by the Merit Evaluation Bureau, not by the Beijing Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 戶部。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 尚書一人，右侍郎一人，司務一人，照磨一人。

translations.literal: One Minister, one Right Vice Minister, one Clerk, one Copying Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister, one Right Vice Minister, one Clerk, and one Copying Clerk.

sentences.zh: 十三司，郎中十三人，員外郎九人，浙江、江西、湖廣、廣東、廣西、福建、山西、陝西、雲南九司各一人，嘉靖三十七年，革山西、陝西三司員外郎各一人，隆慶中又革廣西、雲南二司員外郎各一人。

translations.literal: Thirteen bureaus, thirteen Bureau Directors, nine Vice Bureau Directors—the bureaus of Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huguang, Guangdong, Guangxi, Fujian, Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Yunnan each had one; in the thirty-seventh year of Jiajing one Vice Bureau Director was abolished from each of the three Shanxi and Shaanxi bureaus; in Longqing one Vice Bureau Director was abolished from each of the Guangxi and Yunnan bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen bureaus had thirteen Bureau Directors and nine Vice Bureau Directors; Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huguang, Guangdong, Guangxi, Fujian, Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Yunnan each had one vice director. In Jiajing year 37 (1558) one vice director was cut from each of the three Shanxi and Shaanxi bureaus; under Longqing one was cut from Guangxi and Yunnan as well.

sentences.zh: 主事十七人，山西、廣東、廣西、雲南四司各二人，隆慶三年革廣東司主事一人。

translations.literal: Seventeen Section Chiefs; the bureaus of Shanxi, Guangdong, Guangxi, and Yunnan each had two; in the third year of Longqing one Section Chief was abolished from the Guangdong bureau.
translations.idiomatic: There were seventeen Section Chiefs; Shanxi, Guangdong, Guangxi, and Yunnan each had two. In Longqing year 3 (1569) one Guangdong section chief was abolished.

sentences.zh: 所轄，寶鈔提舉司，提舉一人。

translations.literal: Under its jurisdiction: Paper Money Tax Office, one Tax Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction included a Paper Money Tax Office with one Tax Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 廣積庫、承運庫、贓罰庫、甲乙丙丁戊五字形檔、寶鈔廣惠庫、軍儲倉，各大使一人。

translations.literal: Guangji Warehouse, Chengyun Warehouse, Fines and Confiscations Warehouse, archives for the five character-forms jia, yi, bing, ding, and wu, Baochao Guanghui Warehouse, and Military Grain Storage—each one Grand Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangji, Chengyun, and Fines and Confiscations warehouses; archives for the five character-forms jia, yi, bing, ding, and wu; the Baochao Guanghui warehouse; and Military Grain Storage each had one Grand Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 長安門倉、東安門倉、西安門倉、北安門倉各副使一人。

translations.literal: Chang'an Gate, East Gate, West Gate, and North Gate warehouses each one Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Chang'an Gate, East Gate, West Gate, and North Gate warehouses each had one Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 龍江鹽倉檢校批驗所，大使一人。

translations.literal: Longjiang Salt Warehouse Inspection and Verification Office, one Grand Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Longjiang Salt Warehouse Inspection and Verification Office had one Grand Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 隆慶三年，革寶鈔司提舉、軍儲倉大使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Longqing, the Paper Money Tax Commissioner and Military Grain Storage Grand Commissioner were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing year 3 the Paper Money Tax Commissioner and Military Grain Storage Grand Commissioner were abolished.

sentences.zh: 總督糧儲一人。

translations.literal: One Supervisor of Grain Storage.
translations.idiomatic: One Supervisor of Grain Storage.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖以前，特設都御史。

translations.literal: Before the Jiajing reign, a Censor-in-Chief was specially appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Before Jiajing a Censor-in-Chief was specially appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 二十六年革，以戶部右侍郎加都御史銜領之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year it was abolished; the Right Vice Minister of Revenue with the additional title of Censor-in-Chief took charge.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26 (1547) the special post was abolished; the Right Vice Minister of Revenue, with the additional title of Censor-in-Chief, took over.

sentences.zh: 禮部。

translations.literal: Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 尚書一人，右侍郎一人，司務一人。

translations.literal: One Minister, one Right Vice Minister, one Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister, one Right Vice Minister, and one Clerk.

sentences.zh: 儀制、祠祭、主客、精膳四司，各郎中一人。

translations.literal: Four bureaus—Rites and Protocol, Sacrificial Worship, Receiving Guests, and Fine Foods—each one Bureau Director.
translations.idiomatic: Four bureaus—Rites and Protocol, Sacrificial Worship, Receiving Guests, and Fine Foods—each had one Bureau Director.

sentences.zh: 儀制、祠祭二司，各主事一人。

translations.literal: The Rites and Protocol and Sacrificial Worship bureaus each one Section Chief.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites and Protocol and Sacrificial Worship bureaus each had one Section Chief.

sentences.zh: 所轄，鑄印局，副使一人。

translations.literal: Under its jurisdiction: Seal-Casting Office, one Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction included a Seal-Casting Office with one Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 教坊司，右韶舞一人，左右司樂各一人。

translations.literal: Office of the Imperial Music Bureau: one Right Master of Elegant Dance, one Left and one Right Director of Music.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of the Imperial Music Bureau had one Right Master of Elegant Dance and one Left and one Right Director of Music.

sentences.zh: 兵部。

translations.literal: Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 尚書參贊機務一人，右侍郎一人，司務一人。

translations.literal: One Minister assisting in state affairs, one Right Vice Minister, one Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister assisting in state affairs, one Right Vice Minister, and one Clerk.

sentences.zh: 武選、職方、車駕、武庫四司，郎中四人，員外郎二人，武選、武庫無員外郎。

translations.literal: Four bureaus—Military Selection, Bureau of Appointments, Chariots and Escorts, and Military Stores—four Bureau Directors, two Vice Bureau Directors; the Military Selection and Military Stores bureaus had no vice directors.
translations.idiomatic: Four bureaus—Military Selection, Bureau of Appointments, Chariots and Escorts, and Military Stores—had four Bureau Directors and two Vice Bureau Directors; Military Selection and Military Stores had no vice directors.

sentences.zh: 主事五人。

translations.literal: Five Section Chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Five Section Chiefs.

sentences.zh: 車駕主事二人。

translations.literal: Two Section Chiefs in the Chariots and Escorts bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The Chariots and Escorts bureau had two Section Chiefs.

sentences.zh: 所轄典牧所，提領一人。

translations.literal: Under its jurisdiction: Pasturage Office, one Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction included a Pasturage Office with one Superintendent.

sentences.zh: 正八品。

translations.literal: Rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 8a.

sentences.zh: 會同館、大勝關，各大使一人。

translations.literal: Hall of Joint Harmony and Dasheng Pass, each one Grand Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Joint Harmony and Dasheng Pass each had one Grand Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 按參贊機務，自宣德八年黃福始。

translations.literal: As for assisting in state affairs, it began with Huang Fu in the eighth year of Xuande.
translations.idiomatic: Assisting in state affairs began with Huang Fu in Xuande year 8 (1433).

sentences.zh: 成化二十三年，始奉敕諭，專以本部尚書參贊機務，同內外守備官操練軍馬，撫恤人民，禁戢盜賊，振舉庶務，故其職視五部為特重云。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Chenghua, an imperial edict was first received directing that only the Minister of this ministry should assist in state affairs, together with inner and outer garrison commanders drill troops and horses, comfort and succor the people, restrain bandits and thieves, and revive all routine affairs; therefore this office was regarded as especially weighty among the five ministries.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua year 23 (1487) an imperial edict directed that only this ministry's Minister should assist in state affairs, working with inner and outer garrison commanders to drill troops, comfort the people, suppress banditry, and revive routine administration—hence the post was considered especially weighty among the five ministries.

sentences.zh: 刑部。

translations.literal: Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 尚書一人，右侍郎一人，司務、照磨各一人。

translations.literal: One Minister, one Right Vice Minister, one Clerk and one Copying Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister, one Right Vice Minister, one Clerk, and one Copying Clerk.

sentences.zh: 十三司郎中十三人，員外郎五人，惟浙江、江西、河南、陝西、廣東五司設。

translations.literal: Thirteen bureaus, thirteen Bureau Directors, five Vice Bureau Directors—only the bureaus of Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Henan, Shaanxi, and Guangdong had them.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen Bureau Directors and five Vice Bureau Directors; only Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Henan, Shaanxi, and Guangdong had vice directors.

sentences.zh: 主事十四人，廣東司二人。

translations.literal: Fourteen Section Chiefs; the Guangdong bureau had two.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen Section Chiefs, two in the Guangdong bureau.

sentences.zh: 分掌南京諸司，及公、侯、伯、五府、京衛所刑名之事。

translations.literal: They divided supervision of Nanjing offices and criminal cases of dukes, marquises, earls, the Five Commissions, and capital guard units.
translations.idiomatic: They oversaw Nanjing offices and criminal cases involving dukes, marquises, earls, the Five Commissions, and capital guard units.

sentences.zh: 司獄二人。

translations.literal: Two Prison Superintendents.
translations.idiomatic: Two Prison Superintendents.

sentences.zh: 工部。

translations.literal: Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 尚書一人，右侍郎一人，司務一人。

translations.literal: One Minister, one Right Vice Minister, one Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister, one Right Vice Minister, and one Clerk.

sentences.zh: 營繕、虞衡、都水、屯田四司，郎中四人，員外郎二人，營繕司一人，都水司一人，嘉靖三十七年，革都水員外郎。

translations.literal: Four bureaus—Construction, Forestry and Timber, Hydraulics, and Colonization—four Bureau Directors, two Vice Bureau Directors, one in Construction and one in Hydraulics; in the thirty-seventh year of Jiajing the Hydraulics Vice Bureau Director was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Four bureaus—Construction, Forestry and Timber, Hydraulics, and Colonization—had four Bureau Directors and two Vice Bureau Directors (one each in Construction and Hydraulics); in Jiajing year 37 the Hydraulics vice director was abolished.

sentences.zh: 主事八人。

translations.literal: Eight Section Chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Section Chiefs.

sentences.zh: 營繕司三人，屯田司一人，餘各二人。

translations.literal: Three in the Construction bureau, one in the Colonization bureau, two in each of the others.
translations.idiomatic: Construction had three, Colonization one, and the others two each.

sentences.zh: 所轄，營繕所，所正、所副、所丞各一人。

translations.literal: Under its jurisdiction: Construction Office, one Director, one Deputy Director, and one Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction included a Construction Office with one Director, one Deputy Director, and one Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 龍江、清江二提舉司，各提舉一人。

translations.literal: Longjiang and Qingjiang Tax Offices, each one Tax Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Longjiang and Qingjiang tax offices each had one Tax Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 副提舉後革。

translations.literal: Deputy Tax Commissioners were later abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy tax commissioners were later abolished.

sentences.zh: 文思院、寶源局、軍器局、織染所、龍江抽分竹木局、瓦屑壩抽分竹木局，各大使一人。

translations.literal: Wensi Academy, Baoyuan Bureau, Armory, Dyeing Office, Longjiang Bamboo and Timber Levy Office, and Waxieba Bamboo and Timber Levy Office—each one Grand Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Wensi Academy, Baoyuan Bureau, Armory, Dyeing Office, Longjiang Bamboo and Timber Levy Office, and Waxieba Bamboo and Timber Levy Office each had one Grand Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十七年，革文思院大使。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of Jiajing, the Wensi Academy Grand Commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 37 the Wensi Academy Grand Commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 都察院。

translations.literal: Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate.

sentences.zh: 右都御史一人，右副都御史一人，右僉都御史一人，司務、經歷、都事、照磨各一人，司獄二人。

translations.literal: One Right Censor-in-Chief, one Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, one Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief, one Clerk, one Registrar, one Secretariat Clerk, one Copying Clerk, two Prison Superintendents.
translations.idiomatic: One Right Censor-in-Chief, one Right Vice Censor-in-Chief, one Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief, one Clerk, one Registrar, one Secretariat Clerk, one Copying Clerk, and two Prison Superintendents.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十七年，革司獄一人。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of Jiajing, one Prison Superintendent was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 37 one Prison Superintendent was abolished.

sentences.zh: 隆慶四年，革都事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Longqing, the Secretariat Clerk was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing year 4 (1570) the Secretariat Clerk was abolished.

sentences.zh: 浙江、江西、河南、山東、山西、陝西、四川、雲南、貴州九道，各御史二人。

translations.literal: Nine circuits—Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou—each two Censors.
translations.idiomatic: Nine circuits—Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou—each had two censors.

sentences.zh: 福建、湖廣、廣東、廣西四道，各御史三人。

translations.literal: Four circuits—Fujian, Huguang, Guangdong, and Guangxi—each three Censors.
translations.idiomatic: Four circuits—Fujian, Huguang, Guangdong, and Guangxi—each had three censors.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖後不全設，恆以一人兼數道。

translations.literal: After Jiajing they were not fully staffed; one man commonly held several circuits.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiajing posts were not fully filled; one censor often held several circuits at once.

sentences.zh: 凡刷卷、巡倉、巡江、巡城、屯田、印馬、巡視糧儲、監收糧斛、點閘軍士、管理京營、比驗軍器，皆敘而差之。

translations.literal: For reviewing dossiers, inspecting granaries, patrolling the river, patrolling the city, colonization, branding horses, inspecting grain storage, supervising grain collection, checking sluice troops, managing the capital garrison, and verifying weapons—all were listed and assigned by rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing dossiers, inspecting granaries, river and city patrols, colonization, branding horses, grain storage inspection, grain collection supervision, sluice troop musters, capital garrison management, and weapons verification were all assigned by rotation.

sentences.zh: 清軍，則偕兵部、兵科。

translations.literal: Troop musters were conducted jointly with the Ministry of War and the War Office of Scrutiny.
translations.idiomatic: Troop musters were conducted jointly with the Ministry of War and the War Office of Scrutiny.

sentences.zh: 核後湖黃冊，則偕戶部、戶科。

translations.literal: Auditing the Houhu yellow registers was conducted jointly with the Ministry of Revenue and the Revenue Office of Scrutiny.
translations.idiomatic: Auditing the Houhu yellow registers was conducted jointly with the Ministry of Revenue and the Revenue Office of Scrutiny.

sentences.zh: 提督操江一人。

translations.literal: One Supervisor of River Training.
translations.idiomatic: One Supervisor of River Training.

sentences.zh: 以副僉都御史為之，領上、下江防之事。

translations.literal: A Vice Assistant Censor-in-Chief held the post and directed upper and lower Yangzi river defense.
translations.idiomatic: A Vice Assistant Censor-in-Chief held the post and directed upper and lower Yangzi river defense.

sentences.zh: 通政使司。

translations.literal: Office of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: Office of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 通政使一人，右通政一人，右參議一人，掌收呈狀，付刑部審理。

translations.literal: One Commissioner of Transmission, one Right Commissioner, one Right Assistant Commissioner—supervising receipt of memorials and petitions and forwarding them to the Ministry of Justice for adjudication.
translations.idiomatic: One Commissioner of Transmission, one Right Commissioner, and one Right Assistant Commissioner received memorials and petitions and forwarded them to the Ministry of Justice for adjudication.

sentences.zh: 經歷一人。

translations.literal: One Registrar.
translations.idiomatic: One Registrar.

sentences.zh: 大理寺。

translations.literal: Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 卿一人，右寺丞一人，司務一人，左、右寺正各一人，左、右評事各三人。

translations.literal: One Director, one Right Assistant Director, one Clerk, one Left and one Right Court President, three Left and three Right Reviewers.
translations.idiomatic: One Director, one Right Assistant Director, one Clerk, one Left and one Right Court President, and three Left and three Right Reviewers.

sentences.zh: 隆慶三年，革左、右評事各一人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Longqing, one Left and one Right Reviewer were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing year 3 one Left and one Right Reviewer were abolished.

sentences.zh: 詹事府。

translations.literal: Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Household of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 主簿一人。

translations.literal: One Recorder.
translations.idiomatic: One Recorder.

sentences.zh: 翰林院。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 學士一人，不常置，以翰林坊局官署職。

translations.literal: One Academician, not regularly appointed; Hanlin bureau officials held the post in an acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: One Academician, not regularly appointed; Hanlin bureau officials served in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 孔目一人。

translations.literal: One Archivist.
translations.idiomatic: One Archivist.

sentences.zh: 國子監。

translations.literal: Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 祭酒一人，司業一人，監丞一人，典簿一人，博士三人，助教六人，學正五人，學錄二人，典籍一人，學饌一人。

translations.literal: One Chancellor, one Vice Chancellor, one Supervisor, one Registrar, three Doctors, six Teaching Assistants, five Rectors, two Registrars of Studies, one Keeper of the Classics, one Steward of Student Meals.
translations.idiomatic: One Chancellor, one Vice Chancellor, one Supervisor, one Registrar, three Doctors, six Teaching Assistants, five Rectors, two Registrars of Studies, one Keeper of the Classics, and one Steward of Student Meals.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十七年，革助教二人及掌饌。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of Jiajing, two Teaching Assistants and the Steward of Meals were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 37 two Teaching Assistants and the Steward of Meals were abolished.

sentences.zh: 隆慶四年，革博士一人，學正一人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Longqing, one Doctor and one Rector were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing year 4 one Doctor and one Rector were abolished.

sentences.zh: 太常寺。

translations.literal: Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 卿一人，少卿一人，典簿一人，博士一人，協律郎二人，贊禮郎七人，嘉靖中，革贊禮郎一人。

translations.literal: One Director, one Vice Director, one Registrar, one Doctor, two Masters of Harmonics, seven Masters of Ceremonial—in the Jiajing reign one Master of Ceremonial was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: One Director, one Vice Director, one Registrar, one Doctor, two Masters of Harmonics, and seven Masters of Ceremonial; under Jiajing one Master of Ceremonial was abolished.

sentences.zh: 司樂二人。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Music.
translations.idiomatic: Two Directors of Music.

sentences.zh: 各祠祭署合奉祀八人，祀丞七人。

translations.literal: All sacrificial offices together: eight Sacrificial Officers, seven Assistant Sacrificial Officers.
translations.idiomatic: All sacrificial offices together had eight Sacrificial Officers and seven Assistant Sacrificial Officers.

sentences.zh: 天、地壇奉祀一、祀丞一。

translations.literal: Altars of Heaven and Earth: one Sacrificial Officer, one Assistant Sacrificial Officer.
translations.idiomatic: The Altars of Heaven and Earth each had one Sacrificial Officer and one Assistant Sacrificial Officer.

sentences.zh: 山川壇、耤田奉祀一。

translations.literal: Altars of Mountains and Rivers and the Sacred Plough Field: one Sacrificial Officer each.
translations.idiomatic: The Altars of Mountains and Rivers and the Sacred Plough Field each had one Sacrificial Officer.

sentences.zh: 祖陵奉祀、祀丞各一。

translations.literal: Ancestral Mausoleum: one Sacrificial Officer, one Assistant Sacrificial Officer.
translations.idiomatic: The Ancestral Mausoleum had one Sacrificial Officer and one Assistant Sacrificial Officer.

sentences.zh: 皇陵奉祀、祀丞各二。

translations.literal: Imperial Mausoleum: two Sacrificial Officers, two Assistant Sacrificial Officers.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Mausoleum had two Sacrificial Officers and two Assistant Sacrificial Officers.

sentences.zh: 孝陵、揚王墳、徐王墳各奉祀一，祀丞一。

translations.literal: Xiaoling, the tomb of Prince Yang, and the tomb of Prince Xu each one Sacrificial Officer and one Assistant Sacrificial Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaoling, the tomb of Prince Yang, and the tomb of Prince Xu each had one Sacrificial Officer and one Assistant Sacrificial Officer.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖後，革天地壇、祖陵、揚王墳三祠祭署祀丞。

translations.literal: After Jiajing, the Assistant Sacrificial Officers of the three sacrificial offices at the Altars of Heaven and Earth, Ancestral Mausoleum, and Prince Yang's tomb were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiajing the Assistant Sacrificial Officers at the Altars of Heaven and Earth, Ancestral Mausoleum, and Prince Yang's tomb were abolished.

sentences.zh: 光祿寺。

translations.literal: Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 卿一人，少卿一人，隆慶四年，革少卿。

translations.literal: One Director, one Vice Director; in the fourth year of Longqing the Vice Director was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: One Director and one Vice Director; in Longqing year 4 the Vice Director was abolished.

sentences.zh: 典簿一人。

translations.literal: One Registrar.
translations.idiomatic: One Registrar.

sentences.zh: 大官、珍羞、良醞、掌醢四署，各署正一人，署丞一人。

translations.literal: Four offices—Grand Cuisine, Delicacies, Fine Brew, and Condiments—each one Office Director and one Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: Four offices—Grand Cuisine, Delicacies, Fine Brew, and Condiments—each had one Office Director and one Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，革良醞、掌醢二署署丞。

translations.literal: During the Jiajing reign, the Assistant Directors of the Fine Brew and Condiments offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jiajing the Assistant Directors of the Fine Brew and Condiments offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 萬曆中，革珍羞署丞。

translations.literal: During the Wanli reign, the Assistant Director of the Delicacies office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wanli the Assistant Director of the Delicacies office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 太僕寺。

translations.literal: Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 卿一人，少卿二人，寺丞二人，隆慶中，革少卿一人，寺丞一人。

translations.literal: One Director, two Vice Directors, two Assistant Directors; during Longqing one Vice Director and one Assistant Director were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: One Director, two Vice Directors, and two Assistant Directors; under Longqing one vice director and one assistant director were abolished.

sentences.zh: 主簿一人。

translations.literal: One Recorder.
translations.idiomatic: One Recorder.

sentences.zh: 鴻臚寺。

translations.literal: Court of State Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: Court of State Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 卿一人，主簿一人。

translations.literal: One Director, one Recorder.
translations.idiomatic: One Director and one Recorder.

sentences.zh: 司儀、司賓二署，各署丞一人，鳴贊四人，序班九人。

translations.literal: Two offices—Rites and Reception—each one Assistant Director; four Masters of Acclamation; nine Masters of Order.
translations.idiomatic: Two offices—Rites and Reception—each had one Assistant Director, plus four Masters of Acclamation and nine Masters of Order.

sentences.zh: 尚寶司。

translations.literal: Imperial Seals Office.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Seals Office.

sentences.zh: 卿一人。

translations.literal: One Director.
translations.idiomatic: One Director.

sentences.zh: 吏、戶、禮、兵、刑、工六科。

translations.literal: Six Offices of Scrutiny—Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works.
translations.idiomatic: Six Offices of Scrutiny—Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works.

sentences.zh: 給事中六人。

translations.literal: Six Supervising Secretaries.
translations.idiomatic: Six Supervising Secretaries.

sentences.zh: 又戶科給事中一人，管理後湖黃冊。

translations.literal: In addition, one Supervising Secretary in the Revenue Office managed the Houhu yellow registers.
translations.idiomatic: In addition, one Revenue Office Supervising Secretary managed the Houhu yellow registers.

sentences.zh: 行人司。

translations.literal: Reception Office.
translations.idiomatic: Reception Office.

sentences.zh: 左司副一人。

translations.literal: One Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: One Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 欽天監。

translations.literal: Directorate of Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: Directorate of Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 監正一人，監副一人，主簿一人。

translations.literal: One Director, one Vice Director, one Recorder.
translations.idiomatic: One Director, one Vice Director, and one Recorder.

sentences.zh: 五官正一人，五官靈臺郎二人，五官監候一人，五官司曆一人。

translations.literal: One Director of the Five Offices, two Masters of the Spirit Terrace, one Observer of the Heavens, one Keeper of the Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: One Director of the Five Offices, two Masters of the Spirit Terrace, one Observer of the Heavens, and one Keeper of the Calendar.

sentences.zh: 太醫院。

translations.literal: Imperial Medical Institute.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Medical Institute.

sentences.zh: 院判一人，吏目一人。

translations.literal: One Vice Director, one Clerical Officer.
translations.idiomatic: One Vice Director and one Clerical Officer.

sentences.zh: 惠民藥局、生藥庫，各大使一人。

translations.literal: Public Welfare Pharmacy and Raw Medicines Storehouse, each one Grand Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Public Welfare Pharmacy and Raw Medicines Storehouse each had one Grand Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五城兵馬司。

translations.literal: Five-City Military Patrol Office.
translations.idiomatic: Five-City Military Patrol Office.

sentences.zh: 指揮各一人，副指揮各三人，吏目各一人。

translations.literal: Each city one Commander, three Deputy Commanders, one Clerical Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Each city had one Commander, three Deputy Commanders, and one Clerical Officer.

sentences.zh: 萬曆中，革副指揮每城二人。

translations.literal: During the Wanli reign, two Deputy Commanders per city were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wanli two Deputy Commanders per city were abolished.

sentences.zh: 應天府。

translations.literal: Yingtian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yingtian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 府尹一人，府丞一人，治中一人，通判二人，推官一人，經歷、知事、照磨、檢校各一人。

translations.literal: One Prefect, one Vice Prefect, one Administrative Director, two Vice Prefects for Circuit Affairs, one Investigating Censor, one Registrar, one Administrative Clerk, one Copying Clerk, and one Reviser.
translations.idiomatic: One Prefect, one Vice Prefect, one Administrative Director, two Vice Prefects for Circuit Affairs, one Investigating Censor, one Registrar, one Administrative Clerk, one Copying Clerk, and one Reviser.

sentences.zh: 儒學教授一人，訓導六人。

translations.literal: One Confucian Instructor, six Assistant Instructors.
translations.idiomatic: One Confucian Instructor and six Assistant Instructors.

sentences.zh: 所轄，上元、江寧二縣，各知縣一人，縣丞一人，主簿一人，典史一人。

translations.literal: Under its jurisdiction: Shangyuan and Jiangning counties, each one Magistrate, one Assistant Magistrate, one Recorder, and one Clerical Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction included Shangyuan and Jiangning counties, each with one Magistrate, one Assistant Magistrate, one Recorder, and one Clerical Officer.

sentences.zh: 司獄司，司獄一人。

translations.literal: Prison Office, one Prison Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: A Prison Office with one Prison Superintendent.

sentences.zh: 織染局，大使一人，左、右副使各一人。

translations.literal: Dyeing Office, one Grand Commissioner, one Left and one Right Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: A Dyeing Office with one Grand Commissioner and one Left and one Right Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 都稅司、宣課司，凡四，龍江、江東、聚寶門、太平門。

translations.literal: Metropolitan Tax Offices and Tax Collection Offices, four in all—Longjiang, Jiangdong, Jubao Gate, and Taiping Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Four metropolitan tax and collection offices at Longjiang, Jiangdong, Jubao Gate, and Taiping Gate.

sentences.zh: 稅課局，凡二，龍江、龍潭。

translations.literal: Tax Offices, two in all—Longjiang and Longtan.
translations.idiomatic: Two tax offices at Longjiang and Longtan.

sentences.zh: 各大使一人，副使或一人或二人。

translations.literal: Each one Grand Commissioner; Deputy Commissioners one or two.
translations.idiomatic: Each had one Grand Commissioner and one or two Deputy Commissioners.

sentences.zh: 龍江遞運所，大使、副使各一人。

translations.literal: Longjiang Relay Transport Office, one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Longjiang Relay Transport Office had one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 批驗所，大使一人。

translations.literal: Inspection and Verification Office, one Grand Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An Inspection and Verification Office with one Grand Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 河泊所，官一人。

translations.literal: River Fisheries Office, one official.
translations.idiomatic: A River Fisheries Office with one official.

sentences.zh: 龍江關、石灰山關，各大使一人，副使四人。

translations.literal: Longjiang Pass and Shihuishan Pass, each one Grand Commissioner, four Deputy Commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Longjiang Pass and Shihuishan Pass each had one Grand Commissioner and four Deputy Commissioners in all.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年，改應天府知府為府尹，秩正三品，賜銀印。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongwu, the Yingtian Prefect was renamed Prefect of the Capital, rank 3a, and granted a silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 3 the Yingtian prefect was retitled Prefect of the Capital at rank 3a and granted a silver seal.

sentences.zh: 十三年，始立儒學。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, a Confucian school was first established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 a Confucian school was first established.

sentences.zh: 南京官，自永樂四年成祖往北京，置行部尚書，備行在九卿印以從。

translations.literal: As for Nanjing officials, from the fourth year of Yongle when the Chengzu emperor went to Beijing, traveling Ministers were appointed, carrying the seals of the nine chief ministers at the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: From Yongle year 4, when the Chengzu emperor went to Beijing, traveling ministers were appointed with the seals of the nine chief ministers of the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 是時，皇太子監國，大小庶務悉以委之。

translations.literal: At that time the heir apparent supervised the state; all routine affairs great and small were entrusted to him.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent then supervised the state, and all routine affairs were entrusted to him.

sentences.zh: 惟封爵、大辟、除拜三品以上文武職，則六科都給事中以聞，政本故在南也。

translations.literal: Only enfeoffments, capital punishments, and appointments to civil and military posts of rank 3a and above were reported by the supervising secretaries-in-chief of the Six Offices; the political foundation therefore remained in the south.
translations.idiomatic: Only enfeoffments, capital punishments, and appointments to posts of rank 3a and above were reported by the supervising secretaries-in-chief of the Six Offices—hence the political foundation remained in the south.

sentences.zh: 十八年，官屬悉移而北，南京六部所存惟禮、刑、工三部，各一侍郎，在南之官加「南京。」

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year all officials were moved north; of the Nanjing Six Ministries only Rites, Justice, and Works remained, each with one Vice Minister; officials remaining in the south had the characters "Nanjing" added
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 all officials moved north; of the Nanjing Six Ministries only Rites, Justice, and Works remained, each with one vice minister; officials who stayed in the south had the prefix "Nanjing

sentences.zh: 字於職銜上。

translations.literal: to their titles.
translations.idiomatic: added to their titles.

sentences.zh: 仁宗時補設官屬，除「南京。」

translations.literal: Under the Renzong emperor the official establishment was restored, and the characters "Nanjing
translations.idiomatic: Under Renzong the establishment was restored and the prefix "Nanjing

sentences.zh: 字。

translations.literal: were removed.
translations.idiomatic: was dropped.

sentences.zh: 正統六年，定制復如永樂時。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhengtong, the regulations were fixed again as in the Yongle period.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 6 the regulations were fixed again as under Yongle.

sentences.zh: 王府長史司。

translations.literal: Princely Chief Steward Office.
translations.idiomatic: Princely Chief Steward Office.

sentences.zh: 左、右長史各一人。

translations.literal: One Left and one Right Chief Steward.
translations.idiomatic: One Left and one Right Chief Steward.

sentences.zh: 正五品。

translations.literal: Rank 5a.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 5a.

sentences.zh: 其屬典簿一人，正九品。

translations.literal: Subordinate offices: one Registry Clerk at rank 9a.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates included one Registry Clerk at rank 9a.

sentences.zh: 所轄審理所，審理正一人，正六品；

translations.literal: Under its jurisdiction: Adjudication Office, one Director of Adjudication at rank 6a;
translations.idiomatic: Its jurisdiction included an Adjudication Office with one Director of Adjudication at rank 6a;

sentences.zh: 副一人，正七品。

translations.literal: one Deputy at rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: one Deputy at rank 7a.

sentences.zh: 典膳所，典膳正一人，正八品；

translations.literal: Banquet Office, one Director of Banquets at rank 8a;
translations.idiomatic: a Banquet Office with one Director of Banquets at rank 8a;

sentences.zh: 副一人，從八品。

translations.literal: one Deputy at rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: one Deputy at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 奉祠所，奉祠正一人，正八品；

translations.literal: Sacrificial Office, one Director of Sacrifices at rank 8a;
translations.idiomatic: a Sacrificial Office with one Director of Sacrifices at rank 8a;

sentences.zh: 副一人，從八品。

translations.literal: one Deputy at rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: one Deputy at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 典樂一人，正九品典寶所，典寶正一人，正八品副一人，從八品紀善所，紀善二人，正八品良醫所，良醫正一人，正八品副一人，從八品典儀所，典儀正一人，正九品副一人，從九品工正所，工正一人，正八品副一人，從八品。

translations.literal: One Director of Music at rank 9a; Treasures Office, one Director of Treasures at rank 8a, one Deputy at rank 8b; Rectors Office, two Rectors at rank 8a; Physicians Office, one Chief Physician at rank 8a, one Deputy at rank 8b; Ceremonial Office, one Director of Ceremonial at rank 9a, one Deputy at rank 9b; Works Office, one Master of Works at rank 8a, one Deputy at rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: One Director of Music at rank 9a; a Treasures Office with one Director at rank 8a and one Deputy at rank 8b; a Rectors Office with two Rectors at rank 8a; a Physicians Office with one Chief Physician at rank 8a and one Deputy at rank 8b; a Ceremonial Office with one Director at rank 9a and one Deputy at rank 9b; and a Works Office with one Master of Works at rank 8a and one Deputy at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 以上各所副官，嘉靖四十四年並革。

translations.literal: The deputy officials of all the above offices were abolished together in the forty-fourth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 44 all deputy officials in the above offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 伴讀四人，從九品，後止設一人。

translations.literal: Four Reading Companions at rank 9b; later only one was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Four Reading Companions at rank 9b; later only one was kept.

sentences.zh: 教授無定員，從九品引禮舍二人，後革二人。

translations.literal: Instructors without fixed numbers at rank 9b; two Masters of Ceremonial Introduction, later both abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Instructors without fixed numbers at rank 9b; two Masters of Ceremonial Introduction, later both abolished.

sentences.zh: 倉大使、副使各一人，庫大使、副使各一人。

translations.literal: Warehouse Grand Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner one each; storehouse Grand Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner one each.
translations.idiomatic: Each warehouse and storehouse had one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 倉、庫副使後俱革。

translations.literal: Warehouse and storehouse Deputy Commissioners were later all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Warehouse and storehouse deputy commissioners were later all abolished.

sentences.zh: 郡王府，教授一人，從九品典膳一人。

translations.literal: Princely establishments of the second rank: one Instructor at rank 9b, one Director of Banquets
translations.idiomatic: For commandery princely establishments: one Instructor at rank 9b and one Director of Banquets

sentences.zh: 正八品鎮國將軍教授一人。

translations.literal: at rank 8a; for State-stabilizing Generals, one Instructor
translations.idiomatic: at rank 8a; for state-stabilizing generals, one Instructor

sentences.zh: 從九品

translations.literal: at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 長史，掌王府之政訟，輔相規諷以匡王失，率府僚各供乃事，而總其庶務焉。

translations.literal: The Chief Steward supervised the princely establishment's administration and litigation, assisted and admonished to correct the prince's faults, led the establishment staff each to perform his duties, and oversaw all routine affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Steward oversaw the princely establishment's administration and litigation, advised the prince to correct his faults, led the staff in their duties, and managed all routine affairs.

sentences.zh: 凡請名、請封、請婚、請恩澤，及陳謝、進獻表啟、書疏，長史為王奏上。

translations.literal: For all requests for names, enfeoffments, marriages, and favors, as well as expressions of gratitude, presentations, memorials, and letters, the Chief Steward submitted them on the prince's behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Requests for names, enfeoffments, marriages, and favors, as well as thanks, presentations, memorials, and letters, were submitted by the Chief Steward on the prince's behalf.

sentences.zh: 若王有過，則詰長史。

translations.literal: If the prince committed an offense, the Chief Steward was held accountable.
translations.idiomatic: If the prince erred, the Chief Steward was held accountable.

sentences.zh: 曾經過犯之人，毋得選用是職。

translations.literal: Persons who had previously committed offenses were not to be selected for this office.
translations.idiomatic: Persons with prior offenses were not to be appointed to this office.

sentences.zh: 審理，掌推按刑獄，禁詰橫暴，無幹國紀。

translations.literal: The Director of Adjudication supervised investigation of criminal cases, restrained violence and oppression, and did not interfere in national statutes.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Adjudication investigated criminal cases, restrained violence and oppression, and did not interfere in national law.

sentences.zh: 典膳，掌祭祀、賓客，王若妃之膳羞。

translations.literal: The Director of Banquets supervised sacrifices and guests and the prince's and consort's meals.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Banquets oversaw sacrifices, guests, and the prince's and consort's meals.

sentences.zh: 奉祠，掌祭祀樂舞。

translations.literal: The Director of Sacrifices supervised sacrificial music and dance.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Sacrifices oversaw sacrificial music and dance.

sentences.zh: 典寶，掌王寶符牌。

translations.literal: The Director of Treasures kept the prince's seals, tallies, and plaques.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Treasures kept the prince's seals, tallies, and plaques.

sentences.zh: 紀善，掌諷導禮法，開諭古誼，及國家恩義大節，以詔王善。

translations.literal: The Rector guided the prince in ritual and law, expounded ancient principles and the great principles of state favor and righteousness, and instructed the prince in virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The Rector guided the prince in ritual and law, expounded ancient principles and the great principles of state favor and righteousness, and instructed him in virtue.

sentences.zh: 良醫，掌醫。

translations.literal: The Chief Physician supervised medicine.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Physician supervised medicine.

sentences.zh: 典儀，掌陳儀式。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonial arranged ceremonial observances.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonial arranged ceremonial observances.

sentences.zh: 工正，掌繕造修葺宮邸、廨舍。

translations.literal: The Master of Works supervised construction and repair of palaces and offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Works supervised construction and repair of palaces and offices.

sentences.zh: 伴讀，掌侍從起居，陳設經史。

translations.literal: The Reading Companion attended the prince's daily life and presented the classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: The Reading Companion attended the prince's daily life and presented the classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 教授，掌以德義迪王，校勘經籍。

translations.literal: The Instructor guided the prince with virtue and righteousness and collated the canonical texts.
translations.idiomatic: The Instructor guided the prince with virtue and righteousness and collated the canonical texts.

sentences.zh: 凡宗室年十歲以上，入宗學，教授與紀善為之師。

translations.literal: All members of the imperial clan aged ten and above entered the Clan School; Instructors and Rectors served as their teachers.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansmen aged ten and above entered the Clan School, with Instructors and Rectors as their teachers.

sentences.zh: 引禮，掌接對賓客，贊相威儀。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonial Introduction received guests and assisted in dignified observance.
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Ceremonial Introduction received guests and assisted in dignified observance.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年，置王相府，左、右相各一人，正二品左、右傅各一人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongwu, the Princely Chancellor's Office was established, with one Left and one Right Chancellor at rank 2a and one Left and one Right Tutor at rank 2b.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 3 the Princely Chancellor's Office was established with one Left and one Right Chancellor at rank 2a and one Left and one Right Tutor at rank 2b.

sentences.zh: 從二品參軍府，參軍一人，正五品錄事二人，正七品紀善一人。

translations.literal: At rank 2b, the Staff Office with one Staff Officer at rank 5a, two Recorders at rank 7a, and one Rector at rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: A Staff Office at rank 2b with one Staff Officer at rank 5a, two Recorders at rank 7a, and one Rector at rank 7a.

sentences.zh: 正七品各以其品秩列朝官之次。

translations.literal: At rank 7a, each was ranked among court officials according to his grade.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 7a each was ranked among court officials according to grade.

sentences.zh: 又置典簽司、諮議官。

translations.literal: A Registry Office and Advisory Officials were also established.
translations.idiomatic: A Registry Office and advisory officials were also established.

sentences.zh: 尋以王府武相皆勳臣，令居文相上，王相府官屬仍與朝官更互除授。

translations.literal: Soon because the military chancellors of princely establishments were all meritorious officials, they were ordered to rank above the civil chancellors; princely establishment staff still alternated appointments with court officials.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the military chancellors, all meritorious officials, were ordered to rank above the civil chancellors; princely staff still alternated appointments with court officials.

sentences.zh: 是年置王府教授。

translations.literal: That year princely Instructors were established.
translations.idiomatic: That year princely Instructors were established.

sentences.zh: 四年，更定官制。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the official system was revised.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 the official system was revised.

sentences.zh: 左、右相，正二品，文武傅，從二品，參軍，從五品，錄事，正七品，審理正，正六品，副，正七品，紀善，正七品，各署典祠正、典寶正、典儀正、典膳正、典服正、工正、醫正，並正七品，副，並從七品，牧正，正八品，副，從八品，引禮舍人，省注。

translations.literal: Left and Right Chancellors at rank 2a; civil and military Tutors at rank 2b; Staff Officer at rank 5b; Recorders at rank 7a; Director of Adjudication at rank 6a, Deputy at rank 7a; Rector at rank 7a; Directors of Sacrifices, Treasures, Ceremonial, Banquets, Garments, Works, and Medicine in each office—all at rank 7a, Deputies at rank 7b; Pasturage Director at rank 8a, Deputy at rank 8b; Masters of Ceremonial Introduction as noted by the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Chancellors at rank 2a; civil and military Tutors at rank 2b; Staff Officer at rank 5b; Recorders at rank 7a; Director of Adjudication at rank 6a with Deputy at rank 7a; Rector at rank 7a; directors of sacrifices, treasures, ceremonial, banquets, garments, works, and medicine at rank 7a with deputies at rank 7b; Pasturage Director at rank 8a with Deputy at rank 8b; Masters of Ceremonial Introduction as noted by the ministry.

sentences.zh: 九年，改參軍為長史，罷王傅府及典簽司、諮議官，增設伴讀四人，選老成明經慎行之士任之，侍讀四人，收掌文籍，少則缺之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Staff Officer was changed to Chief Steward; the Tutors' Office, Registry Office, and Advisory Officials were abolished; four Reading Companions were added, chosen from mature, learned, and prudent men; four Attendant Readers kept the documents, fewer if not needed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 Staff Officer became Chief Steward; the Tutors' Office, Registry Office, and advisory officials were abolished; four Reading Companions were added, chosen from mature and prudent scholars; four Attendant Readers kept the documents, fewer if not needed.

sentences.zh: 尋改王相府所屬奉祠、典寶、典膳、良醫、工正各所正並紀善俱正八品，副，從八品。

translations.literal: Soon the Directors of Sacrifices, Treasures, Banquets, Physicians, and Works under the Princely Chancellor's Office and the Rectors were all set at rank 8a, Deputies at rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: Soon directors of sacrifices, treasures, banquets, physicians, and works and the Rectors were all set at rank 8a, deputies at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 十三年，並罷王相府，升長史司為正五品，置左、右長史各一人，典簿一人，定王府孳牲所、倉庫等官俱為雜職。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the Princely Chancellor's Office was abolished entirely; the Chief Steward Office was raised to rank 5a with one Left and one Right Chief Steward and one Registry Clerk; officials of the princely sacrificial livestock office, warehouses, and the like were all fixed as miscellaneous posts.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 the Princely Chancellor's Office was abolished; the Chief Steward Office was raised to rank 5a with one Left and one Right Chief Steward and one Registry Clerk; sacrificial livestock, warehouse, and similar posts were fixed as miscellaneous offices.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，置靖江王府諮議所，諮議、記室、教授各一人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, the Jingjiang Princely Advisory Office was established with one Advisor, one Secretary, and one Instructor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 the Jingjiang princely Advisory Office was established with one Advisor, one Secretary, and one Instructor.

sentences.zh: 建文中，增置親王賓輔二人，伴讀、伴講、伴書各一人，長史三人。

translations.literal: During the Jianwen reign, two Guest Ministers were added for imperial princes, one Reading Companion, one Lecturing Companion, and one Writing Companion each, and three Chief Stewards.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jianwen two Guest Ministers were added for imperial princes, plus one Reading, Lecturing, and Writing Companion each and three Chief Stewards.

sentences.zh: 郡王賓友二人，教授一人，記室二人，直史一人，左、右直史各一人，吏目一人，典印、典祠、典禮、典饌、典藥五署官各一人，典儀二人，引禮舍人二人，儀仗司，吏目一人。

translations.literal: For commandery princes: two Guest Friends, one Instructor, two Secretaries, one Direct Historian, one Left and one Right Direct Historian, one Clerical Officer, one official each in the Seal, Sacrifice, Rites, Food, and Medicine offices, two Directors of Ceremonial, two Masters of Ceremonial Introduction, and an Equipage Office with one Clerical Officer.
translations.idiomatic: For commandery princes: two Guest Friends, one Instructor, two Secretaries, one Direct Historian with Left and Right assistants, one Clerical Officer, one official each in the Seal, Sacrifice, Rites, Food, and Medicine offices, two Directors of Ceremonial, two Masters of Ceremonial Introduction, and an Equipage Office with one Clerical Officer.

sentences.zh: 其賓輔、三伴、賓友、教授進見時，侍坐，稱名而不稱臣，禮如賓師。

translations.literal: When Guest Ministers, the three Companions, Guest Friends, and Instructors were received in audience, they were seated beside the prince, addressed by name rather than as subjects, and treated with the ceremony due to guests and teachers.
translations.idiomatic: When received in audience, Guest Ministers, the three Companions, Guest Friends, and Instructors sat beside the prince, were addressed by name rather than as subjects, and were treated as guests and teachers.

sentences.zh: 成祖初，復舊制，改靖江王府諮議所為長史司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Chengzu reign the old system was restored; the Jingjiang Princely Advisory Office was changed to a Chief Steward Office.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Chengzu's reign the old system was restored and the Jingjiang Advisory Office became a Chief Steward Office.

sentences.zh: 萬曆間，周府設宗正一人。

translations.literal: During the Wanli reign, the Zhou princely establishment appointed one Director of the Imperial Lineage.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wanli the Zhou princely establishment appointed one Director of the Imperial Lineage.

sentences.zh: 後各府亦漸置。

translations.literal: Later other establishments gradually appointed them as well.
translations.idiomatic: Later other establishments gradually did the same.

sentences.zh: 郡王府增設教授一人。

translations.literal: Commandery princely establishments gained an additional Instructor.
translations.idiomatic: Commandery princely establishments gained an additional Instructor.

sentences.zh: 又洪武七年，公主府設家令一人，正七品司丞一人，正八品錄事一人。

translations.literal: Also in the seventh year of Hongwu, princess establishments had one Household Director at rank 7a, one Assistant Director at rank 8a, and one Recorder at rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 7 princess establishments had one Household Director at rank 7a, one Assistant Director at rank 8a, and one Recorder at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 正九品二十三年，改家令司為中使司，以內使為之。

translations.literal: At rank 9a; in the twenty-third year the Household Director's Office was changed to the Palace Attendants Office, staffed by inner eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 9a; in year 23 the Household Director's Office became the Palace Attendants Office, staffed by inner eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 承宣佈政使司。

translations.literal: Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Administration Commission.

sentences.zh: 左、右布政使各一人，從二品；

translations.literal: One Left and one Right Administration Commissioner, rank 2b;
translations.idiomatic: One Left and one Right Administration Commissioner at rank 2b;

sentences.zh: 左、右參政，從三品；

translations.literal: Left and Right Vice Commissioners, rank 3b;
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Vice Commissioners at rank 3b;

sentences.zh: 左、右參議，無定員。

translations.literal: Left and Right Assistant Commissioners, without fixed numbers,
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Assistant Commissioners without fixed numbers,

sentences.zh: 從四品。

translations.literal: rank 4b.
translations.idiomatic: at rank 4b.

sentences.zh: 參政、參議因事添設，各省不等，詳諸道。

translations.literal: Vice and Assistant Commissioners were added as needed; numbers varied by province—see the circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Vice and Assistant Commissioners were added as needed; numbers varied by province—see the circuits.

sentences.zh: 經歷司，經歷一人，從六品；

translations.literal: Registry, one Registrar at rank 6b;
translations.idiomatic: a Registry with one Registrar at rank 6b;

sentences.zh: 都事一人，從七品。

translations.literal: one Secretariat Clerk at rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: one Secretariat Clerk at rank 7b.

sentences.zh: 照磨所，照磨一人，從八品；

translations.literal: Copying Office, one Copying Clerk at rank 8b;
translations.idiomatic: a Copying Office with one Copying Clerk at rank 8b;

sentences.zh: 檢校一人，正九品。

translations.literal: one Reviser at rank 9a.
translations.idiomatic: one Reviser at rank 9a.

sentences.zh: 理問所，理問一人，從六品；

translations.literal: Adjudication Office, one Adjudicator at rank 6b;
translations.idiomatic: an Adjudication Office with one Adjudicator at rank 6b;

sentences.zh: 副理問一人，從七品；

translations.literal: one Deputy Adjudicator at rank 7b;
translations.idiomatic: one Deputy Adjudicator at rank 7b;

sentences.zh: 提控案牘一人。

translations.literal: one Controller of Documents.
translations.idiomatic: one Controller of Documents.

sentences.zh: 司獄司，司獄一人，從九品。

translations.literal: Prison Office, one Prison Superintendent at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: a Prison Office with one Prison Superintendent at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 庫大使一人，從九品；

translations.literal: Storehouse Grand Commissioner at rank 9b;
translations.idiomatic: one Storehouse Grand Commissioner at rank 9b;

sentences.zh: 副使一人。

translations.literal: one Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: one Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 倉大使一人，從九品；

translations.literal: Warehouse Grand Commissioner at rank 9b;
translations.idiomatic: one Warehouse Grand Commissioner at rank 9b;

sentences.zh: 副使一人。

translations.literal: one Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: one Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 雜造局、軍器局、寶泉局、織染局，各大使一人，從九品副使一人。

translations.literal: Miscellaneous Manufactures, Armory, Mint, and Dyeing bureaus—each one Grand Commissioner at rank 9b and one Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous Manufactures, Armory, Mint, and Dyeing bureaus each had one Grand Commissioner at rank 9b and one Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 所轄衙門各省不同，詳見雜職。

translations.literal: Subordinate offices varied by province; see Miscellaneous Posts for details.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate offices varied by province; see Miscellaneous Posts for details.

sentences.zh: 布政使，掌一省之政，朝廷有德澤、禁令，承流宣播，以下於有司。

translations.literal: The Administration Commissioner supervised a province's government; when the court had favors or prohibitions, he received and proclaimed them down to the local offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Administration Commissioner governed the province; court favors and prohibitions were received and proclaimed down to local offices.

sentences.zh: 凡僚屬滿秩，廉其稱職、不稱職，上下其考，報撫、按以達於吏部、都察院。

translations.literal: When subordinates completed their terms, he assessed whether they were competent, adjusted their evaluations, and reported through the grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner to the Ministry of Personnel and Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: When subordinates completed their terms, he assessed their competence, adjusted their evaluations, and reported through the grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner to the Ministry of Personnel and Censorate.

sentences.zh: 三年，率其府州縣正官朝覲京師，以聽察典。

translations.literal: Every three years he led prefectural, departmental, and county chief officials to court in the capital for inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Every three years he led prefectural, departmental, and county chiefs to the capital for inspection.

sentences.zh: 十年，會戶版以登民數、田數。

translations.literal: Every ten years he compiled household registers to record population and land.
translations.idiomatic: Every ten years he compiled household registers to record population and land.

sentences.zh: 賓興貢，合省之士而提調之。

translations.literal: For the provincial examinations he assembled the province's scholars and supervised them.
translations.idiomatic: For the provincial examinations he assembled and supervised the province's scholars.

sentences.zh: 宗室、官吏、師生、軍伍，以時班其祿俸、廩糧。

translations.literal: For the imperial clan, officials, teachers and students, and troops, he distributed salaries and grain rations on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: He distributed salaries and grain rations on schedule to the imperial clan, officials, teachers and students, and troops.

sentences.zh: 祀典神祗，謹其時祀。

translations.literal: For statutory sacrifices to the gods, he ensured timely observance.
translations.idiomatic: He ensured timely observance of statutory sacrifices to the gods.

sentences.zh: 民鰥寡孤獨者養之，孝弟貞烈者表揚之，水旱疾疫災祲，則請於上蠲振之。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary were supported; the filial, fraternal, and chaste were commended; for flood, drought, plague, or calamity he requested relief from above.
translations.idiomatic: He supported widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary; commended the filial, fraternal, and chaste; and requested relief from the throne for flood, drought, plague, or calamity.

sentences.zh: 凡貢賦役，視府州縣土地人民豐瘠多寡而均其數。

translations.literal: For all tribute, taxes, and corvée, he equalized amounts according to the wealth or poverty and population of each prefecture, department, and county.
translations.idiomatic: He equalized tribute, taxes, and corvée according to each prefecture's, department's, and county's land and population.

sentences.zh: 凡有大興革及諸政務，會都、按議，經畫定而請於撫、按若總督。

translations.literal: For major reforms and all government affairs, he met with metropolitan and surveillance officials, planned and settled matters, then submitted to the grand coordinator, surveillance commissioner, or governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: For major reforms and government affairs, he met with metropolitan and surveillance officials, settled plans, and submitted them to the grand coordinator, surveillance commissioner, or governor-general.

sentences.zh: 其國慶國哀，遣僚貳朝賀弔祭於京師。

translations.literal: For national celebrations or mourning, he sent deputies to the capital to offer congratulations or condolences.
translations.idiomatic: For national celebrations or mourning he sent deputies to the capital to offer congratulations or condolences.

sentences.zh: 天子即位，則左布政使親至。

translations.literal: When the Son of Heaven took the throne, the Left Administration Commissioner came in person.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor took the throne, the Left Administration Commissioner came in person.

sentences.zh: 參政、參議分守各道，及派管糧儲、屯田、清軍、驛傳、水利、撫民等事，並分司協管京畿。

translations.literal: Vice and Assistant Commissioners guarded each circuit and were assigned grain storage, colonization, troop musters, courier relay, hydraulics, and civilian pacification, and also assisted in governing the capital region by rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Vice and Assistant Commissioners guarded each circuit and handled grain storage, colonization, troop musters, courier relay, hydraulics, and civilian pacification, and also assisted in governing the capital region by rotation.

sentences.zh: 兩京不設布、按，無參政，參議、副使、僉事，故於旁近布、按分司帶管，詳見各道。

translations.literal: The two capitals had no administration or surveillance commissions and no Vice Commissioners, Assistant Commissioners, Vice Directors, or Assistant Directors; nearby commissions therefore supervised by rotation—see the circuits.
translations.idiomatic: The two capitals had no administration or surveillance commissions; nearby commissions supervised by rotation—see the circuits.

sentences.zh: 經歷、都事，典受發文移，其詳巡按、巡鹽御史文書，用經歷印。

translations.literal: The Registrar and Secretariat Clerk received and dispatched documents; detailed documents of touring censors and salt censors used the registrar's seal.
translations.idiomatic: The Registrar and Secretariat Clerk received and dispatched documents; touring censor and salt censor documents used the registrar's seal.

sentences.zh: 照磨、檢校典勘理卷宗。

translations.literal: The Copying Clerk and Reviser collated dossiers.
translations.idiomatic: The Copying Clerk and Reviser collated dossiers.

sentences.zh: 理問典刑名。

translations.literal: The Adjudicator supervised criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: The Adjudicator supervised criminal cases.

sentences.zh: 初，太祖下集慶，自領江南行中書省。

translations.literal: At first, when the Taizu emperor took Jiqing, he personally headed the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizu emperor took Jiqing, he personally headed the Jiangnan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，置中書分省於婺州。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day, a branch secretariat was established at Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day a branch secretariat was established at Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 後每略定地方，即置行省，其官自平章政事以下，大略與中書省同。

translations.literal: Later, whenever a region was pacified, a branch secretariat was established; its officials from the Chief Minister down were largely the same as at the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a region was pacified, a branch secretariat was established with officials largely mirroring the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 設行省平章政事，從一品左、右丞，正二品參知政事。

translations.literal: A branch Chief Minister at rank 1b, Left and Right Vice Ministers at rank 2a, and Administrative Vice Ministers at rank 2b were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Posts included a branch Chief Minister at rank 1b, Left and Right Vice Ministers at rank 2a, and Administrative Vice Ministers at rank 2b.

sentences.zh: 從二品左、右司，郎中，從五品員外郎，從六品都事、檢校，從七品照磨、管勾。

translations.literal: At rank 2b, Left and Right Bureaus; Bureau Directors at rank 5b; Vice Bureau Directors at rank 6b; Secretariat Clerks and Revisers at rank 7b; Copying Clerks and Controllers at rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Bureaus at rank 2b; Bureau Directors at rank 5b; Vice Bureau Directors at rank 6b; Secretariat Clerks and Revisers at rank 7b; Copying Clerks and Controllers at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 從八品理問所，正理問，正四品副理問，正五品，知事，從八品尋改知事為提控案牘。

translations.literal: At rank 8b, an Adjudication Office with Chief Adjudicator at rank 4a, Deputy Adjudicator at rank 5a, and Clerk at rank 8b—later the Clerk was renamed Controller of Documents.
translations.idiomatic: An Adjudication Office at rank 8b with Chief Adjudicator at rank 4a, Deputy at rank 5a, and Clerk at rank 8b—later retitled Controller of Documents.

sentences.zh: 省注洪武九年，改浙江、江西、福建、北平、廣西、四川、山東、廣東、河南、陝西、湖廣、山西諸行省俱為承宣佈政使司，罷行省平章政事，左、右丞等官，改參知政事為布政使，秩正二品，左、右參政，從二品，改左、右司為經歷司。

translations.literal: Ministry note: In Hongwu year 9 all branch secretariats of Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian, Beiping, Guangxi, Sichuan, Shandong, Guangdong, Henan, Shaanxi, Huguang, and Shanxi were changed to Provincial Administration Commissions; branch Chief Ministers and Vice Ministers were abolished; Administrative Vice Ministers became Administration Commissioners at rank 2a with Left and Right Vice Commissioners at rank 2b; Left and Right Bureaus became Registries.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 9 all branch secretariats became Provincial Administration Commissions; branch chief and vice ministers were abolished; administrative vice ministers became Administration Commissioners at rank 2a with vice commissioners at rank 2b; bureaus became registries.

sentences.zh: 十三年改布政使，正三品，參政，從三品。

translations.literal: In year 13 the Administration Commissioner was set at rank 3a and the Vice Commissioner at rank 3b.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 the commissioner was set at rank 3a and the vice commissioner at rank 3b.

sentences.zh: 十四年，增置左、右參議，正四品。

translations.literal: In year 14 Left and Right Assistant Commissioners at rank 4a were added.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 Left and Right Assistant Commissioners at rank 4a were added.

sentences.zh: 尋增設左、右布政使各一人。

translations.literal: Soon one Left and one Right Administration Commissioner were added.
translations.idiomatic: Soon one Left and one Right Administration Commissioner were added.

sentences.zh: 十五年，置雲南布政司。

translations.literal: In year 15 the Yunnan Administration Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 the Yunnan Administration Commission was established.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，定秩從二品。

translations.literal: In year 22 the rank was fixed at 2b.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 the rank was fixed at 2b.

sentences.zh: 建文中，升正二品，裁一人。

translations.literal: Under Jianwen it was raised to rank 2a and one post was cut.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jianwen it was raised to rank 2a and one post was cut.

sentences.zh: 成祖復舊制。

translations.literal: The Chengzu emperor restored the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzu restored the old system.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年以北平布政司為北京。

translations.literal: In Yongle 1 the Beiping Administration Commission became Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1 the Beiping Administration Commission became Beijing.

sentences.zh: 五年，置交阯布政司。

translations.literal: In year 5 the Jiaozhi Administration Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 the Jiaozhi Administration Commission was established.

sentences.zh: 十一年，置貴州布政司。

translations.literal: In year 11 the Guizhou Administration Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 the Guizhou Administration Commission was established.

sentences.zh: 止設使一人，餘官如各布政司。

translations.literal: Only one commissioner was appointed; other officials were as in other commissions.
translations.idiomatic: Only one commissioner was appointed; other officials matched other commissions.

sentences.zh: 宣德三年，罷交址布政司，除兩京外，定為十三布政司。

translations.literal: In Xuande year 3 the Jiaozhi commission was abolished; apart from the two capitals, thirteen administration commissions were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande year 3 Jiaozhi was abolished; apart from the two capitals, thirteen administration commissions were fixed.

sentences.zh: 初置籓司，與六部均重。

translations.literal: When the provincial commissions were first established, they were equal in weight to the Six Ministries.
translations.idiomatic: When first established, provincial commissions were equal in weight to the Six Ministries.

sentences.zh: 布政使入為尚書、侍郎，副都御史每出為布政使。

translations.literal: Administration Commissioners entered the capital as ministers and vice ministers; vice censors-in-chief often went out as administration commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Administration commissioners entered the capital as ministers and vice ministers; vice censors-in-chief often went out as administration commissioners.

sentences.zh: 宣德、正統間猶然，自後無之。

translations.literal: This remained so through Xuande and Zhengtong; afterward it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: This remained so through Xuande and Zhengtong; afterward it ceased.

sentences.zh: 提刑按察使司。

translations.idiomatic: Provincial Surveillance Commission.

sentences.zh: 按察使一人，正三品副使，正四品僉事無定員。

translations.idiomatic: One Surveillance Commissioner at rank 3a; Vice Commissioners at rank 4a; Assistant Commissioners without fixed numbers

sentences.zh: 正五品。

translations.literal: at rank 5a.
translations.idiomatic: at rank 5a.

sentences.zh: 詳見諸道。

translations.idiomatic: See the circuits for details.

sentences.zh: 經歷司，經歷一人，正七品知事一人。

translations.literal: Registry, one Registrar at rank 7a, one Administrative Clerk
translations.idiomatic: a Registry with one Registrar at rank 7a and one Administrative Clerk

sentences.zh: 正八品照磨所，照磨一人，正九品檢校一人。

translations.idiomatic: at rank 8a; a Copying Office with one Copying Clerk at rank 9a and one Reviser

sentences.zh: 按察使，掌一省刑名按劾之事。

translations.literal: The Surveillance Commissioner supervised a province's criminal investigation and impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: The Surveillance Commissioner supervised a province's criminal investigation and impeachment.

sentences.zh: 糾官邪，戢奸暴，平獄訟，雪冤抑，以振揚風紀，而澄清其吏治。

translations.idiomatic: He corrected corrupt officials, restrained violence, settled lawsuits, redressed injustice, upheld discipline, and clarified local governance.

sentences.zh: 大者暨都、布二司會議，告撫、按，以聽於部、院。

translations.idiomatic: Major cases were discussed with metropolitan and administration commissions, reported to the grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner, and referred to the ministries and censorate.

sentences.zh: 凡朝覲慶吊之禮，具如布政司。

translations.idiomatic: Court audiences and congratulatory or condolence rites followed the same procedures as the administration commission.

sentences.zh: 明初，置提刑按察司。

translations.idiomatic: In year 14 it was restored and circuit surveillance branch offices were established.

translations.idiomatic: In year 15 surveillance branch offices were also established in all prefectures, departments, and counties.

translations.idiomatic: 531 scholars including Wang Cunzhong were appointed trial Assistant Commissioners, each overseeing two counties.

sentences.zh: 凡官吏賢否、軍民利病，皆得廉問糾舉。

translations.literal: For the merit or fault of officials and the welfare or harm of troops and civilians, all could be investigated and impeached.
translations.idiomatic: They could investigate and impeach officials' merit or fault and troops' and civilians' welfare or harm.

translations.idiomatic: In year 16 trial Assistant Commissioners were abolished; the commissioner was set at rank 3b, two vice commissioners at rank 4b, and assistant commissioners at rank 5b in numbers matching the circuits.

translations.idiomatic: In year 22 the Surveillance Commissioner was again fixed at rank 3a.

translations.idiomatic: In year 29 surveillance branch offices were reorganized into forty-one circuits.

translations.literal: Military circuits were modeled on the Hongxi period: because military officers were weak in literary matters, Vice Commissioners Shen Gu, Liu Shao, and others were sent to each regional commander's headquarters to organize documents and discuss secret plans—they never personally commanded military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Military circuits were modeled on the Hongxi period: because military officers were weak in paperwork, Vice Commissioners Shen Gu, Liu Shao, and others were sent to each regional commander's headquarters to organize documents and discuss secret plans—they never personally commanded troops.

translations.idiomatic: By the Hongzhi period Minister of War Ma Wensheng, fearing neglect of military duties, proposed adding one Vice Assistant Commissioner with an imperial commission.

translations.idiomatic: Because the two capitals had no administration or surveillance commissions, education supervision was assigned to censors.

translations.idiomatic: Traveling Office of the Imperial Stud.

translations.idiomatic: Branding, equal distribution, levy oversight, and breeding of all cavalry drill horses were supervised on schedule.

translations.idiomatic: Each spring and autumn growth, decline, and tooth color were inspected; every three years a full comparison was made; administration and surveillance commissions were not permitted to participate.

sentences.zh: 有瘠損，則聽兵部參罰。

translations.literal: If there was emaciation or loss, the Ministry of War was allowed to impeach and punish.
translations.idiomatic: If horses were emaciated or lost, the Ministry of War could impeach and punish those responsible.

sentences.zh: 苑馬寺亦如之。

translations.literal: Stud Farms were the same.
translations.idiomatic: Stud Farms followed the same procedures.

translations.idiomatic: In Shanxi, Beiping, and Shaanxi, each office had one Vice Director and three Assistant Directors;

translations.idiomatic: in Gansu and Liaodong, each office had one Vice Director and one Assistant Director, chosen from retired commanders and company and battalion officers.

translations.idiomatic: In Yongle year 4 office officials were permitted to investigate and punish guard and battalion pacification officers and leading officials under their jurisdiction.

translations.idiomatic: In year 18 the Beijing traveling Office of the Imperial Stud became the Court of the Imperial Stud.
