translations.literal: In Jiajing year 3, at Censor Chen Jiang's request, one Vice Director was added to each of the Shaanxi and Gansu offices to divide supervision of Yan-Sui and Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 3, at Censor Chen Jiang's request, one Vice Director was added to each of the Shaanxi and Gansu offices to supervise Yan-Sui and Ningxia separately.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，令寺官遇聖節，輪年齎進表文。

translations.literal: In year 29 office officials were ordered, on imperial festivals, to take turns presenting memorials.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 office officials were ordered to take turns presenting memorials on imperial festivals.

sentences.zh: 苑馬寺。

translations.literal: Stud Farms.
translations.idiomatic: Stud Farms.

sentences.zh: 卿一人，從三品少卿一人，正四品寺丞無定員，正六品其屬，主簿一人，從七品各牧監，監正一人，正九品監副一人，從九品錄事一人。

translations.literal: One Director at rank 3b, one Vice Director at rank 4a, Assistant Directors without fixed numbers at rank 6a; subordinates: one Recorder at rank 7b; for each stud farm one Superintendent at rank 9a, one Assistant Superintendent at rank 9b, and one Clerk.
translations.idiomatic: One Director at rank 3b, one Vice Director at rank 4a, and Assistant Directors without fixed numbers at rank 6a; subordinates included one Recorder at rank 7b; each stud farm had one Superintendent at rank 9a, one Assistant Superintendent at rank 9b, and one Clerk.

sentences.zh: 各苑，圉長一人。

translations.literal: For each stud, one Stable Master.
translations.idiomatic: Each stud had one Stable Master.

sentences.zh: 從九品掌六監二十四苑之馬政，而聽於兵部。

translations.literal: At rank 9b, they managed horse administration for six superintendencies and twenty-four studs, subject to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Stable Masters at rank 9b managed horse administration for six superintendencies and twenty-four studs, subject to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 凡苑，視廣狹為三等：上苑牧馬萬匹，中苑七千，下苑四千。

translations.literal: Studs were graded in three classes by area: upper studs pastured ten thousand horses, middle studs seven thousand, lower studs four thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Studs were graded in three classes by area: upper studs pastured ten thousand horses, middle studs seven thousand, and lower studs four thousand.

sentences.zh: 凡牧地，曰草場，曰荒地，曰熟地，嚴禁令而封表之。

translations.literal: Pasture land was classified as meadow, wasteland, or cultivated land; strict prohibitions were enforced and boundaries marked.
translations.idiomatic: Pasture land was classified as meadow, wasteland, or cultivated land; strict prohibitions were enforced and boundaries marked.

sentences.zh: 凡牧人，曰恩軍，曰隊軍，曰改編之軍，曰充發之軍，曰召募之軍，曰抽選之軍，皆籍而食之。

translations.literal: Herdsmen were classified as favor troops, company troops, reorganized troops, conscripted troops, recruited troops, and selected troops; all were registered and provisioned.
translations.idiomatic: Herdsmen were classified as favor troops, company troops, reorganized troops, conscripted troops, recruited troops, and selected troops; all were registered and provisioned.

sentences.zh: 凡馬駒，歲籍其監苑之數，上於兵部，以聽考課。

translations.literal: As for foals, each year the numbers in each superintendent's stud were registered and reported to the Ministry of War for performance evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the number of foals in each superintendent's stud was registered and reported to the Ministry of War for performance evaluation.

sentences.zh: 監正、副掌監苑之牧事，圉長帥羣長而阜蕃馬匹。

translations.literal: Superintendents and assistant superintendents managed pasturing affairs in the superintendencies and studs; Stable Masters led herd leaders to breed and multiply horses.
translations.idiomatic: Superintendents and assistant superintendents managed pasturing in their superintendencies and studs; Stable Masters led herd leaders in breeding and multiplying the horses.

sentences.zh: 永樂四年，置苑馬寺凡四：北直隸、遼東、平涼、甘肅。

translations.literal: In Yongle year 4 four Stud Farms were established: in North Zhili, Liaodong, Pingliang, and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle year 4 four Stud Farms were established, in North Zhili, Liaodong, Pingliang, and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 五年，增設北直隸苑馬寺六監二十四苑。

translations.literal: In year 5 six superintendencies and twenty-four studs were added to the North Zhili Stud Farm.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 six superintendencies and twenty-four studs were added to the North Zhili Stud Farm.

sentences.zh: 順義、長春、鹹和、馴良四苑，隸清河監。

translations.literal: The four studs Shunyi, Changchun, Xianhe, and Xunliang were subject to the Qinghe Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: The Shunyi, Changchun, Xianhe, and Xunliang studs were subject to the Qinghe Superintendent.

sentences.zh: 水州、隆萃、大牧、遂甯，隸金臺監。

translations.literal: Shuizhou, Longcui, Damu, and Suining were subject to the Jintai Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Shuizhou, Longcui, Damu, and Suining were subject to the Jintai Superintendent.

sentences.zh: 汧池、鹿鳴、龍河、長興，隸涿鹿監。

translations.literal: Qianchi, Luming, Longhe, and Changxing were subject to the Zhuolu Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Qianchi, Luming, Longhe, and Changxing were subject to the Zhuolu Superintendent.

sentences.zh: 遼陽、龍山、萬安、蕃昌，隸盧龍監。

translations.literal: Liaoyang, Longshan, Wan'an, and Fanchang were subject to the Lulong Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Liaoyang, Longshan, Wan'an, and Fanchang were subject to the Lulong Superintendent.

sentences.zh: 清流、廣蕃、龍泉、松林，隸香山監。

translations.literal: Qingliu, Guangfan, Longquan, and Songlin were subject to the Xiangshan Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Qingliu, Guangfan, Longquan, and Songlin were subject to the Xiangshan Superintendent.

sentences.zh: 河陽、崇義、興甯、永成，隸通州監。

translations.literal: Heyang, Chongyi, Xingning, and Yongcheng were subject to the Tongzhou Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Heyang, Chongyi, Xingning, and Yongcheng were subject to the Tongzhou Superintendent.

sentences.zh: 六年增甘肅、平涼二寺監。

translations.literal: In year 6 superintendencies were added to the Gansu and Pingliang Stud Farms.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 superintendencies were added to the Gansu and Pingliang Stud Farms.

sentences.zh: 每寺各六監二十四苑。

translations.literal: Each farm had six superintendencies and twenty-four studs.
translations.idiomatic: Each farm had six superintendencies and twenty-four studs.

sentences.zh: 十八年，革北京苑馬寺，併入太僕。

translations.literal: In year 18 the Beijing Stud Farm was abolished and merged into the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 the Beijing Stud Farm was abolished and merged into the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 正統四年，革甘肅苑馬寺，改牧恩軍於黑水口，隸長樂監。

translations.literal: In Zhengtong year 4 the Gansu Stud Farm was abolished; favor troops were reassigned to pasture at Heishui Pass, subject to the Changle Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 4 the Gansu Stud Farm was abolished; favor troops were reassigned to pasture at Heishui Pass under the Changle Superintendent.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年革平涼寺丞一員。

translations.literal: In Hongzhi year 2 one Assistant Director of the Pingliang Stud Farm was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi year 2 one Assistant Director of the Pingliang Stud Farm was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十七年，都御史楊一清奏請行太僕、苑馬二寺員缺，簡選才望參政、副使補升卿，參議、僉事補升少卿，以振馬政。

translations.literal: In year 17 Censor-in-Chief Yang Yiqing memorialized requesting that vacant posts in the Court of the Imperial Stud and Stud Farms be filled by selecting talented and reputable Administration Vice Commissioners and Surveillance Vice Commissioners for promotion to Director, and Administration Counselors and Regional Inspectors for promotion to Vice Director, to revitalize horse administration.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 Censor-in-Chief Yang Yiqing memorialized that vacant posts in the Court of the Imperial Stud and Stud Farms be filled by promoting talented Administration Vice Commissioners and Surveillance Vice Commissioners to Director and Administration Counselors and Regional Inspectors to Vice Director, to revitalize horse administration.

sentences.zh: 十八年又請添設寺員。

translations.literal: In year 18 he again requested additional posts in the farms.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 he again requested additional posts in the farms.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十二年，以遼東寺卿張思兼轄金、復、蓋州三衛軍民。

translations.literal: In Jiajing year 32 Liaodong Stud Farm Director Zhang Si was concurrently charged with governing the military and civilian populations of the Jin, Fu, and Gaizhou guards.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing year 32 Liaodong Stud Farm Director Zhang Si was concurrently charged with governing the military and civilian populations of the Jin, Fu, and Gaizhou guards.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，又命帶理兵備事。

translations.literal: In year 42 he was also ordered to manage military preparedness affairs concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: In year 42 he was also ordered to manage military preparedness affairs concurrently.

sentences.zh: 都轉運鹽使司。

translations.literal: Salt Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Salt Transport Commission.

sentences.zh: 都轉運使一人，從三品同知一人，從四品副使一人，從五品判官無定員。

translations.literal: One Grand Transport Commissioner at rank 3b, one Vice Commissioner at rank 4b, one Assistant Commissioner at rank 5b, and Transport Judges without fixed numbers.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand Transport Commissioner at rank 3b, one Vice Commissioner at rank 4b, one Assistant Commissioner at rank 5b, and Transport Judges without fixed numbers.

sentences.zh: 從六品其屬，經歷司，經歷一人，從七品知事一人，從八品庫大使、副使各一人。

translations.literal: Subordinates at rank 6b: in the Experience Office one Registry Director at rank 7b and one Registry Clerk at rank 8b; one Storehouse Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates at rank 6b included one Registry Director at rank 7b and one Registry Clerk at rank 8b in the Experience Office, and one Storehouse Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 所轄，各場鹽課司大使、副使，各鹽倉大使、副使，各批驗所大使、副使，並一人。

translations.literal: Under its jurisdiction each Salt Tax Office, each salt warehouse, and each inspection and verification office had one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Under its jurisdiction each Salt Tax Office, salt warehouse, and inspection and verification office had one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 俱未入流

translations.literal: All were outside the regular rank stream.
translations.idiomatic: All were outside the regular rank stream.

sentences.zh: 都轉運使。

translations.literal: Grand Transport Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Transport Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 掌鹽監之事。

translations.literal: He managed salt production and supervision affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He managed salt production and supervision affairs.

sentences.zh: 同知、副判分司之。

translations.literal: The Vice Commissioner and Transport Judge divided supervision of subordinate offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Commissioner and Transport Judge divided supervision of subordinate offices.

sentences.zh: 都轉運鹽使司凡六：曰兩淮，曰兩浙，曰長蘆，曰河東，曰山東，曰福建。

translations.literal: There were six Salt Transport Commissions: Liang-Huai, Liang-Zhe, Changlu, Hedong, Shandong, and Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: There were six Salt Transport Commissions: Liang-Huai, Liang-Zhe, Changlu, Hedong, Shandong, and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 分司十四：泰州、淮安、通州隸兩淮，嘉興、松江、甯紹、溫臺隸兩浙，滄州、青州隸長蘆，膠萊、濱樂隸山東，解鹽東場、西場、中場隸河東。

translations.literal: There were fourteen branch offices: Taizhou, Huai'an, and Tongzhou under Liang-Huai; Jiaxing, Songjiang, Ning-Shao, and Wen-Tai under Liang-Zhe; Cangzhou and Qingzhou under Changlu; Jiaolai and Binle under Shandong; and the eastern, western, and middle fields of solution salt under Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: There were fourteen branch offices: Taizhou, Huai'an, and Tongzhou under Liang-Huai; Jiaxing, Songjiang, Ning-Shao, and Wen-Tai under Liang-Zhe; Cangzhou and Qingzhou under Changlu; Jiaolai and Binle under Shandong; and the eastern, western, and middle solution-salt fields under Hedong.

sentences.zh: 分副使若副判蒞之，督各場倉鹽課司，以總於都轉運使，共奉巡鹽御史或鹽法道臣之政令。

translations.literal: Branch assistant commissioners or transport judges presided over them, supervising the various field offices, warehouses, and Salt Tax Offices and reporting in aggregate to the Grand Transport Commissioner, jointly obeying the orders of the touring salt censor or salt-law circuit official.
translations.idiomatic: Branch assistant commissioners or transport judges presided over them, supervising field offices, warehouses, and Salt Tax Offices and reporting to the Grand Transport Commissioner, jointly obeying the touring salt censor or salt-law circuit official.

sentences.zh: 福建、山東無巡鹽御史，餘詳《食貨志·鹽法》中。

translations.literal: Fujian and Shandong had no touring salt censor; for the rest see "Salt Laws" in the Treatise on Food and Money.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian and Shandong had no touring salt censor; for the rest see "Salt Laws" in the Treatise on Food and Money.

sentences.zh: 鹽課提舉司。

translations.literal: Salt Tax Office.
translations.idiomatic: Salt Tax Office.

sentences.zh: 提舉一人，從五品同提舉一人，從六品副提舉無定員。

translations.literal: One Tax Commissioner at rank 5b, one Vice Tax Commissioner at rank 6b, and Assistant Tax Commissioners without fixed numbers at rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: One Tax Commissioner at rank 5b, one Vice Tax Commissioner at rank 6b, and Assistant Tax Commissioners without fixed numbers at rank 7b.

sentences.zh: 從七品其屬，吏目一人，從九品庫大使、副使一人。

translations.literal: Subordinates: one Clerical Officer at rank 9b; one Storehouse Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates included one Clerical Officer at rank 9b and one Storehouse Grand Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 所轄，各鹽倉大使、副使，各場、各井鹽課司大使、副使，並一人。

translations.literal: Under its jurisdiction each salt warehouse, each field, and each well Salt Tax Office had one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Under its jurisdiction each salt warehouse, field, and well Salt Tax Office had one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 提舉司凡七：曰四川，曰廣東海北，廉州曰黑鹽井，楚雄曰白鹽井，姚安曰安寧，曰五井，大理曰察罕腦兒。

translations.literal: There were seven Salt Tax Offices: Sichuan; Guangdong Haibei; Heiyan Well at Lianzhou; Baiyan Well at Chuxiong; Anning and Wujing at Yao'an; and Chahan Naor in Dali.
translations.idiomatic: There were seven Salt Tax Offices: Sichuan; Guangdong Haibei; Heiyan Well at Lianzhou; Baiyan Well at Chuxiong; Anning and Wujing at Yao'an; and Chahan Naor in Dali.

sentences.zh: 又有遼東煎鹽提舉司。

translations.literal: There was also the Liaodong Boiled-Salt Tax Office.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Liaodong Boiled-Salt Tax Office.

sentences.zh: 提舉，正七品，同提舉，正八品，副提舉，正九品。

translations.literal: For this office the Tax Commissioner was rank 7a, the Vice Tax Commissioner rank 8a, and the Assistant Tax Commissioner rank 9a.
translations.idiomatic: For this office the Tax Commissioner was rank 7a, the Vice Tax Commissioner rank 8a, and the Assistant Tax Commissioner rank 9a.

sentences.zh: 其職掌皆如都轉運司。

translations.literal: Their duties were the same as those of the Salt Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Their duties were the same as those of the Salt Transport Commission.

sentences.zh: 明初，置都轉運司於兩淮。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the dynasty a Salt Transport Commission was established in Liang-Huai.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the dynasty a Salt Transport Commission was established in Liang-Huai.

sentences.zh: 吳元年，置兩浙都轉運司於杭州，定都轉運使秩正三品，設同知，正四品副使，正五品運判，正六品經歷，正七品知事，正八品照磨、綱官，正九品鹽場設司令，從七品司丞，從八品百夫長。

translations.literal: In Wu 1 the Liang-Zhe Salt Transport Commission was established at Hangzhou; the Grand Transport Commissioner was fixed at rank 3a, with a Vice Commissioner at rank 4a, Assistant Commissioner at rank 5a, Transport Judge at rank 6a, Registry Director at rank 7a, Archivist and Transport Overseer at rank 8a, and Salt Field Commander at rank 9a, Assistant Director at rank 7b, and Company Officer at rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: In Wu 1 the Liang-Zhe Salt Transport Commission was established at Hangzhou; the Grand Transport Commissioner was fixed at rank 3a, with a Vice Commissioner at rank 4a, Assistant Commissioner at rank 5a, Transport Judge at rank 6a, Registry Director at rank 7a, Archivist and Transport Overseer at rank 8a, Salt Field Commander at rank 9a, Assistant Director at rank 7b, and Company Officer at rank 8b.

sentences.zh: 省注洪武二年置長蘆、河東二都轉運司，及廣東海北鹽課提舉司，尋又置山東、福建二都轉運司。

translations.literal: Provincial note: in Hongwu year 2 the Changlu and Hedong Salt Transport Commissions and the Guangdong Haibei Salt Tax Office were established; soon after the Shandong and Fujian Salt Transport Commissions were also established.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial note: in Hongwu year 2 the Changlu and Hedong Salt Transport Commissions and the Guangdong Haibei Salt Tax Office were established; soon after the Shandong and Fujian Salt Transport Commissions were also established.

sentences.zh: 三年，又於陝西察罕腦兒之地置鹽課提舉司，後漸增置各處。

translations.literal: In year 3 a Salt Tax Office was also established at Chahan Naor in Shaanxi; later such offices were gradually added in various places.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 a Salt Tax Office was also established at Chahan Naor in Shaanxi; later such offices were gradually added in various places.

sentences.zh: 建文中，改廣東提舉為都轉運司。

translations.literal: During the Jianwen reign the Guangdong Salt Tax Office was changed to a Salt Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jianwen reign the Guangdong Salt Tax Office was changed to a Salt Transport Commission.

sentences.zh: 永樂初復故。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongle the previous arrangement was restored.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yongle the previous arrangement was restored.

sentences.zh: 十四年，初命御史巡鹽。

translations.literal: In year 14 censors were first dispatched to tour salt regions.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 censors were first dispatched to tour salt regions.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年，罷長蘆、兩淮巡鹽御史，命撫、按官兼理。

translations.literal: In Jingtai year 3 touring salt censors for Changlu and Liang-Huai were abolished and grand coordinators and surveillance commissioners were ordered to handle the duty concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai year 3 touring salt censors for Changlu and Liang-Huai were abolished and grand coordinators and surveillance commissioners were ordered to handle the duty concurrently.

sentences.zh: 已復遣御史，其無御史者，分按察司理之。

translations.literal: Later censors were again dispatched; where there was no censor, the provincial surveillance commission divided responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Later censors were again dispatched; where there was no censor, the provincial surveillance commission divided responsibility.

sentences.zh: 又洪武中，於四川置茶鹽都轉運司，洪武五年置，設官如都轉運鹽使司。

translations.literal: Also in the Hongwu reign a Tea and Salt Transport Commission was established in Sichuan in Hongwu year 5, with officials appointed like those of the Salt Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Also in the Hongwu reign a Tea and Salt Transport Commission was established in Sichuan in Hongwu year 5, with officials appointed like those of the Salt Transport Commission.

sentences.zh: 十年罷。

translations.literal: It was abolished in year 10.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in year 10.

sentences.zh: 納溪、白渡二鹽馬司，洪武五年置，以常選官為司令，內使為司丞。

translations.literal: The Naxi and Baidu Salt-and-Horse offices were established in Hongwu year 5, with regularly selected officials as commanders and eunuchs as assistant directors.
translations.idiomatic: The Naxi and Baidu Salt-and-Horse offices were established in Hongwu year 5, with regularly selected officials as commanders and eunuchs as assistant directors.

sentences.zh: 十三年罷，尋復置。

translations.literal: They were abolished in year 13, then soon reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: They were abolished in year 13, then soon reestablished.

sentences.zh: 十五年，改設大使、副使各一人。

translations.literal: In year 15 they were reorganized with one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner each.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 they were reorganized with one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner each.

sentences.zh: 後並革。

translations.literal: Later both were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Later both were abolished.

sentences.zh: 又有順龍鹽馬司，亦革。

translations.literal: There was also the Shunlong Salt-and-Horse Office, which was also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: There was also the Shunlong Salt-and-Horse Office, which was also abolished.

sentences.zh: 市舶提舉司。

translations.literal: Maritime Trade Office.
translations.idiomatic: Maritime Trade Office.

sentences.zh: 提舉一人，從五品副提舉二人。

translations.literal: One Trade Commissioner at rank 5b and two Vice Trade Commissioners at rank 6b.
translations.idiomatic: One Trade Commissioner at rank 5b and two Vice Trade Commissioners at rank 6b.

sentences.zh: 從六品其屬，吏目一人。

translations.literal: Subordinates: one Clerical Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates included one Clerical Officer.

sentences.zh: 從九品掌海外諸蕃朝貢市易之事，辨其使人表文勘合之真偽，禁通番，徵私貨，平交易，閑其出入而慎館穀之。

translations.literal: At rank 9b he managed tribute and trade from overseas foreign states, verified the authenticity of envoys' memorials and inspection tallies, prohibited unauthorized contact with foreigners, levied contraband, balanced transactions, regulated entry and exit, and carefully provisioned guest lodging.
translations.idiomatic: At rank 9b he managed tribute and trade from overseas foreign states, verified envoys' memorials and inspection tallies, prohibited unauthorized contact with foreigners, levied contraband, balanced transactions, regulated entry and exit, and carefully provisioned guest lodging.

sentences.zh: 吳元年，置市舶提舉司。

translations.literal: In Wu 1 the Maritime Trade Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Wu 1 the Maritime Trade Office was established.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年，罷太倉、黃渡市舶司。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 3 the Taicang and Huangdu maritime trade offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 3 the Taicang and Huangdu maritime trade offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 七年，罷福建之泉州、浙江之明州、廣東之廣州三市舶司。

translations.literal: In year 7 the maritime trade offices at Quanzhou in Fujian, Mingzhou in Zhejiang, and Guangzhou in Guangdong were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 the maritime trade offices at Quanzhou in Fujian, Mingzhou in Zhejiang, and Guangzhou in Guangdong were abolished.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年復置，設官如洪武初制，尋命內臣提督之。

translations.literal: In Yongle 1 they were reestablished with officials as in the early Hongwu system; soon eunuchs were ordered to supervise them.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 1 they were reestablished with officials as in the early Hongwu system; soon eunuchs were ordered to supervise them.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年，給事中夏言奏倭禍起於市舶，遂革福建、浙江二市舶司，惟存廣東市舶司。

translations.literal: In Jiajing 1 Supervising Secretary Xia Yan memorialized that the Japanese piracy troubles originated in maritime trade, so the Fujian and Zhejiang maritime trade offices were abolished, leaving only the Guangdong office.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 1 Supervising Secretary Xia Yan memorialized that Japanese piracy troubles originated in maritime trade, so the Fujian and Zhejiang maritime trade offices were abolished, leaving only the Guangdong office.

sentences.zh: 茶馬司。

translations.literal: Tea and Horse Office.
translations.idiomatic: Tea and Horse Office.

sentences.zh: 大使一人，正九品副使一人，從九品掌市馬之事。

translations.literal: One Grand Commissioner at rank 9a and one Deputy Commissioner at rank 9b, managing horse-trading affairs.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand Commissioner at rank 9a and one Deputy Commissioner at rank 9b managed horse-trading affairs.

sentences.zh: 洪武中，置洮州、秦州、河州三茶馬司，設司令、司丞。

translations.literal: In the Hongwu reign three Tea and Horse Offices were established at Taozhou, Qinzhou, and Hezhou, with commanders and assistant directors.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongwu reign three Tea and Horse Offices were established at Taozhou, Qinzhou, and Hezhou, with commanders and assistant directors.

sentences.zh: 十五年改設大使、副使各一人，尋罷洮州茶馬司，以河州茶馬司兼領之。

translations.literal: In year 15 they were reorganized with one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner each; soon the Taozhou office was abolished and the Hezhou Tea and Horse Office took charge of its duties.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 they were reorganized with one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner each; soon the Taozhou office was abolished and the Hezhou Tea and Horse Office took charge of its duties.

sentences.zh: 三十年，改秦州茶馬司為西寧茶馬司。

translations.literal: In year 30 the Qinzhou Tea and Horse Office was renamed the Xining Tea and Horse Office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 the Qinzhou Tea and Horse Office was renamed the Xining Tea and Horse Office.

sentences.zh: 又洪武中，置四川永甯茶馬司，後革，復置雅州碉門茶馬司。

translations.literal: Also in the Hongwu reign the Yongning Tea and Horse Office was established in Sichuan; later abolished, then the Diaomen Tea and Horse Office at Yazhou was reestablished.
translations.idiomatic: Also in the Hongwu reign the Yongning Tea and Horse Office was established in Sichuan; later abolished, then the Diaomen Tea and Horse Office at Yazhou was reestablished.

sentences.zh: 又於廣西置慶遠裕民司，洪武七年置，設大使一人，從八品，副使一人，正九品。

translations.literal: Also in Guangxi the Qingyuan Yumin Office was established in Hongwu year 7, with one Grand Commissioner at rank 8b and one Deputy Commissioner at rank 9a.
translations.idiomatic: Also in Guangxi the Qingyuan Yumin Office was established in Hongwu year 7, with one Grand Commissioner at rank 8b and one Deputy Commissioner at rank 9a.

sentences.zh: 市八番溪洞之馬，後亦革。

translations.literal: It traded horses from the eight fan tribes of the streams and caves; later it too was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It traded horses from the eight fan tribes of the streams and caves; later it too was abolished.

sentences.zh: 府。

translations.literal: Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 知府一人，正四品同知，正五品通判無定員，正六品推官一人。

translations.literal: One Prefect at rank 4a, one Vice Prefect at rank 5a, Magistrates without fixed numbers at rank 6a, and one Push Officer at rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: One Prefect at rank 4a, one Vice Prefect at rank 5a, Magistrates without fixed numbers at rank 6a, and one Push Officer at rank 7a.

sentences.zh: 正七品其屬，經歷司經歷一人，正八品知事一人。

translations.literal: Subordinates: one Registry Director at rank 8a and one Registry Clerk at rank 9a in the Experience Office.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates included one Registry Director at rank 8a and one Registry Clerk at rank 9a in the Experience Office.

sentences.zh: 正九品照磨所，照磨一人，從九品檢校一人。

translations.literal: Archives Office: one Archivist at rank 9a and one Proofreader at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: The Archives Office had one Archivist at rank 9a and one Proofreader at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 司獄司，司獄一人。

translations.literal: Prison Office: one Prison Director.
translations.idiomatic: The Prison Office had one Prison Director.

sentences.zh: 所轄別見

translations.literal: Jurisdiction listed separately.
translations.idiomatic: Jurisdiction is listed separately.

sentences.zh: 知府，掌一府之政，宣風化，平獄訟，均賦役，以教養百姓。

translations.literal: The Prefect managed a prefecture's affairs, spread moral influence, adjudicated litigation, equalized levies and corvée, and nurtured and taught the people.
translations.idiomatic: The Prefect managed a prefecture's affairs, spread moral influence, adjudicated litigation, equalized levies and corvée, and nurtured and taught the people.

sentences.zh: 每三歲，察屬吏之賢否，上下其考，以達於省，上吏部。

translations.literal: Every three years he assessed subordinate officials' competence, adjusted their evaluations, and reported through the province to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Every three years he assessed subordinate officials' competence, adjusted their evaluations, and reported through the province to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 凡朝賀、弔祭，視布政使司，直隸府得專達。

translations.literal: For court congratulations and mourning sacrifices he followed the Provincial Administration Commission; directly administered prefectures could report directly.
translations.idiomatic: For court congratulations and mourning sacrifices he followed the Provincial Administration Commission; directly administered prefectures could report directly.

sentences.zh: 凡詔赦、例令、勘答刂至，謹受之，下所屬奉行。

translations.literal: When imperial amnesties, regulations, and official dispatches arrived, he received them reverently and ordered subordinates to carry them out.
translations.idiomatic: When imperial amnesties, regulations, and official dispatches arrived, he received them reverently and ordered subordinates to carry them out.

sentences.zh: 所屬之政，皆受約束於府，劑量輕重而令之，大者白於撫、按、布、按，議允乃行。

translations.literal: All subordinate administration was bound by the prefecture; he weighed matters by importance and issued orders; major matters were reported to the grand coordinator, surveillance commissioner, and administration and surveillance commissions, and executed only after agreement.
translations.idiomatic: All subordinate administration was bound by the prefecture; he weighed matters by importance and issued orders; major matters were reported to the grand coordinator, surveillance commissioner, and administration and surveillance commissions, and executed only after agreement.

sentences.zh: 凡賓興科貢，提調學校，修明祀典之事，鹹掌之。

translations.literal: He fully managed provincial examinations, coordinated schools, and maintained sacrificial statutes.
translations.idiomatic: He fully managed provincial examinations, coordinated schools, and maintained sacrificial statutes.

sentences.zh: 若籍帳、軍匠、驛遞、馬牧、盜賊、倉庫、河渠、溝防、道路之事，雖有專官，皆總領而稽覈之。

translations.literal: For household registers, military artisans, courier relay, horse pasturing, banditry, warehouses, rivers, ditches, embankments, and roads—though there were specialized officials—he oversaw and audited them all.
translations.idiomatic: For household registers, military artisans, courier relay, horse pasturing, banditry, warehouses, rivers, ditches, embankments, and roads—though there were specialized officials—he oversaw and audited them all.

sentences.zh: 同知、通判分掌清軍、巡捕、管糧、治農、水利、屯田、牧馬等事。

translations.literal: The Vice Prefect and Magistrate divided responsibility for troop muster rolls, patrol and arrest, grain management, agriculture, waterworks, military colonies, and horse pasturing.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Prefect and Magistrate divided responsibility for troop muster rolls, patrol and arrest, grain management, agriculture, waterworks, military colonies, and horse pasturing.

sentences.zh: 無常職，各府所掌不同，如延安、延綏同知又兼牧民，餘不盡載。

translations.literal: They had no fixed duties; each prefecture differed, as when the Yan'an and Yansui vice prefects also herded the people—not all are recorded here.
translations.idiomatic: They had no fixed duties; each prefecture differed, as when the Yan'an and Yansui vice prefects also herded the people—not all are recorded here.

sentences.zh: 無定員。

translations.literal: Without fixed numbers.
translations.idiomatic: Without fixed numbers.

sentences.zh: 邊府同知有增至六、七員者。

translations.literal: In border prefectures vice prefects were sometimes increased to six or seven.
translations.idiomatic: In border prefectures vice prefects were sometimes increased to six or seven.

sentences.zh: 推官理刑名，贊計典。

translations.literal: The Push Officer handled criminal cases and assisted in fiscal administration.
translations.idiomatic: The Push Officer handled criminal cases and assisted in fiscal administration.

sentences.zh: 各府推官，洪武三年始設。

translations.literal: Push Officers in all prefectures were first established in Hongwu year 3.
translations.idiomatic: Push Officers in all prefectures were first established in Hongwu year 3.

sentences.zh: 經歷、照磨、檢校受發上下文移，磨勘六房宗卷。

translations.literal: Registry Directors, Archivists, and Proofreaders sent and received documents up and down and audited the main files of the six sections.
translations.idiomatic: Registry Directors, Archivists, and Proofreaders sent and received documents up and down and audited the main files of the six sections.

sentences.zh: 明初，改諸路為府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the dynasty all lu circuits were changed to prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the dynasty all lu circuits were changed to prefectures.

sentences.zh: 洪武六年，分天下府三等：糧二十萬石以上為上府，知府秩從三品；

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 6 prefectures nationwide were divided into three grades: upper prefectures with more than 200,000 shi of grain, prefect at rank 3b;
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 6 prefectures nationwide were divided into three grades: upper prefectures with more than 200,000 shi of grain had prefects at rank 3b;

sentences.zh: 二十萬石以下為中府，知府正四品；

translations.literal: middle prefectures with less than 200,000 shi, prefect at rank 4a;
translations.idiomatic: middle prefectures with less than 200,000 shi had prefects at rank 4a;

sentences.zh: 十萬石以下為下府，知府，從四品。

translations.literal: lower prefectures with less than 100,000 shi, prefect at rank 4b.
translations.idiomatic: lower prefectures with less than 100,000 shi had prefects at rank 4b.

sentences.zh: 已，並為正四品。

translations.literal: Later all were made rank 4a.
translations.idiomatic: Later all were made rank 4a.

sentences.zh: 七年，減北方府州縣官三百八人。

translations.literal: In year 7 three hundred eight officials in northern prefectures, departments, and counties were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 three hundred eight officials in northern prefectures, departments, and counties were reduced.

sentences.zh: 十三年，選國子學生二十四人為府州縣官。

translations.literal: In year 13 twenty-four students of the Imperial Academy were selected as prefecture, department, and county officials.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 twenty-four students of the Imperial Academy were selected as prefecture, department, and county officials.

sentences.zh: 六月罷各府照磨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Archivists in all prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Archivists in all prefectures were abolished.

sentences.zh: 二十七年復置。

translations.literal: In year 27 they were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 (1394) they were restored.

sentences.zh: 自宣德三年棄交阯布政司，計天下府凡一百五十有九。

translations.literal: Since the Jiaozhi Provincial Administration Commission was abandoned in Xuande year 3, prefectures nationwide totaled one hundred fifty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jiaozhi Provincial Administration Commission was abandoned in Xuande year 3 (1428), prefectures nationwide numbered one hundred fifty-nine.

sentences.zh: 州。

translations.literal: Department.
translations.idiomatic: Department.

sentences.zh: 知州一人，從五品同知，從六品判官無定員，從七品。

translations.literal: One Department Magistrate at rank 5b, one Vice Magistrate at rank 6b, Assistant Magistrates without fixed numbers at rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: One Department Magistrate at rank 5b, one Vice Magistrate at rank 6b, and Assistant Magistrates without fixed numbers at rank 7b.

sentences.zh: 裏不及三十而無屬縣，裁同知、判官。

translations.literal: If registered households were less than thirty li and there were no subordinate counties, the Vice Magistrate and Assistant Magistrates were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: If registered households totaled less than thirty li and there were no subordinate counties, the Vice Magistrate and Assistant Magistrates were cut.

sentences.zh: 有屬縣，裁同知。

translations.literal: If there were subordinate counties, the Vice Magistrate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: If there were subordinate counties, only the Vice Magistrate was cut.

sentences.zh: 其屬，吏目一人，從九品。

translations.literal: Subordinates: one Clerical Officer at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates included one Clerical Officer at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 所轄別見。

translations.literal: Jurisdiction listed separately.
translations.idiomatic: Jurisdiction is listed separately.

sentences.zh: 知州，掌一州之政。

translations.literal: The Department Magistrate managed a department's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Department Magistrate managed a department's affairs.

sentences.zh: 凡州二：有屬州，有直隸州。

translations.literal: Departments were of two kinds: subordinate departments and directly controlled departments.
translations.idiomatic: Departments fell into two types: subordinate departments and directly controlled departments.

sentences.zh: 屬州視縣，直隸州視府，而品秩則同。

translations.literal: Subordinate departments were treated like counties; directly controlled departments like prefectures; but ranks were the same.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate departments were treated like counties and directly controlled departments like prefectures, though their ranks were identical.

sentences.zh: 同知、判官，俱視其事州之繁簡，以供厥職。

translations.literal: Vice Magistrates and Assistant Magistrates both depended on how busy or quiet the department was to perform their duties.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Magistrates and Assistant Magistrates were both appointed according to how demanding the department was, that they might fulfill their posts.

sentences.zh: 計天下州凡二百三十有四。

translations.literal: Departments nationwide totaled two hundred thirty-four.
translations.idiomatic: Departments nationwide numbered two hundred thirty-four.

sentences.zh: 縣。

translations.literal: County.
translations.idiomatic: County.

sentences.zh: 知縣一人，正七品縣丞一人，正八品主簿一人，正九品其屬，典史一人。

translations.literal: One County Magistrate at rank 7a, one Assistant Magistrate at rank 8a, one Recorder at rank 9a; subordinates included one Clerical Officer.
translations.idiomatic: One County Magistrate at rank 7a, one Assistant Magistrate at rank 8a, one Recorder at rank 9a; subordinates included one Clerical Officer.

sentences.zh: 所轄別見

translations.literal: Jurisdiction listed separately.
translations.idiomatic: Jurisdiction is listed separately.

sentences.zh: 知縣，掌一縣之政。

translations.literal: The County Magistrate managed a county's affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The County Magistrate managed a county's affairs.

sentences.zh: 凡賦役，歲會實徵，十年造黃冊，以丁產為差。

translations.literal: For levies and corvée he annually tallied actual collections; every ten years he compiled the Yellow Register, graded by adult males and property.
translations.idiomatic: For levies and corvée he annually reconciled actual collections; every ten years he compiled the Yellow Register, distinguishing households by adult males and property.

sentences.zh: 賦有金谷、布帛及諸貨物之賦，役有力役、僱役、借債不時之役，皆視天時休咎，地利豐耗，人力貧富，調劑而均節之。

translations.literal: Levies included grain, money, cloth, and other goods; corvée included labor service, hired service, and emergency levies—all adjusted according to weather, harvest, land, and wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Levies covered grain, money, cloth, and other goods; corvée covered labor service, hired service, and emergency levies—all balanced according to the season's fortune, the land's yield, and the people's means.

sentences.zh: 歲歉則請於府若省蠲減之。

translations.literal: In lean years he petitioned the prefecture or province for relief or reduction.
translations.idiomatic: In years of famine he petitioned the prefecture or province for remission or reduction.

sentences.zh: 凡養老、祀神、貢士、讀法、表善良、恤窮乏、稽保甲、嚴緝捕、聽獄訟，皆躬親厥職而勤慎焉。

translations.literal: Caring for the elderly, sacrifices to the gods, recommending scholars, reading the law, honoring the virtuous, aiding the destitute, auditing the baojia system, strict pursuit of criminals, and hearing lawsuits—all he performed personally, diligently and carefully.
translations.idiomatic: Whether caring for the aged, sacrificing to the gods, recommending scholars, reading the law aloud, commending the virtuous, relieving the poor, auditing the baojia rolls, tightening pursuit of criminals, or hearing lawsuits—he attended to each duty himself, with diligence and care.

sentences.zh: 若山海澤藪之產，足以資國用者，則按籍而致貢。

translations.literal: Products from mountains, seas, marshes, and wetlands sufficient for state use were registered and sent as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Where products of mountains, seas, marshes, and wetlands could serve the state's needs, he registered them and forwarded tribute according to the rolls.

sentences.zh: 縣丞、主簿分掌糧馬、巡捕之事。

translations.literal: The Assistant Magistrate and Recorder divided responsibility for grain, horses, and patrol and arrest.
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant Magistrate and Recorder divided grain supplies, horses, and patrol and arrest.

sentences.zh: 典史典文移出納。

translations.literal: The Clerical Officer managed documents and receipts and disbursements.
translations.idiomatic: The Clerical Officer kept documents and handled receipts and disbursements.

sentences.zh: 如無縣丞，或無主簿，則分領丞簿職。

translations.literal: If there was no Assistant Magistrate or no Recorder, he took over their duties.
translations.idiomatic: If there was no Assistant Magistrate or no Recorder, the Clerical Officer assumed their duties.

sentences.zh: 縣丞、主簿，添革不一。

translations.literal: Assistant Magistrates and Recorders were added or abolished inconsistently.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Magistrates and Recorders were added or abolished without uniform rule.

sentences.zh: 若編戶不及二十里者並裁。

translations.literal: If registered households were less than twenty li, both were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Where registered households totaled less than twenty li, both posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 吳元年，定縣三等：糧十萬石以下為上縣，知縣從六品；

translations.literal: In the Wu reign year, counties were divided into three grades: upper counties with less than 100,000 shi of grain had county magistrates at rank 6b;
translations.idiomatic: In the Wu reign year counties were graded in three tiers: upper counties, with grain levies below 100,000 shi, had county magistrates at rank 6b;

sentences.zh: 六萬石以下為中縣，知縣正七品；

translations.literal: middle counties with less than 60,000 shi had county magistrates at rank 7a;
translations.idiomatic: middle counties, with less than 60,000 shi, had county magistrates at rank 7a;

sentences.zh: 三萬石以下為下縣，知縣從七品。

translations.literal: lower counties with less than 30,000 shi had county magistrates at rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: lower counties, with less than 30,000 shi, had county magistrates at rank 7b.

sentences.zh: 已，並為正七品。

translations.literal: Later all were made rank 7a.
translations.idiomatic: Later all were standardized at rank 7a.

sentences.zh: 凡新授郡縣官，給道里費。

translations.literal: All newly appointed prefecture and county officials received travel expenses.
translations.idiomatic: All newly appointed prefecture and county officials were granted travel expenses.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，徵天下賢才為府州縣職，敕命厚賜，以勵其廉恥，又敕諭之至於再。

translations.literal: In Hongwu 1 the dynasty summoned talented men nationwide for prefecture, department, and county posts, issuing edicts with generous gifts to encourage integrity, and admonishing them again and again.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 (1368) the court summoned talented men from across the realm to serve in prefectures, departments, and counties, issuing edicts with generous gifts to stir their sense of honor, and repeating its admonitions again and again.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，定府州縣條例八事，頒示天下，永為遵守。

translations.literal: In year 37 eight regulations for prefectures, departments, and counties were fixed and promulgated nationwide as rules forever to be observed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 37 (1404) eight regulations for prefectures, departments, and counties were established and issued to the realm as rules to be observed in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 是時，天下府州縣官廉能正直者，必遣行人齎敕往勞，增秩賜金。

translations.literal: At that time, whenever a prefecture, department, or county official proved honest, capable, and upright, an envoy was dispatched bearing an imperial edict to commend him, with promotion in rank and gifts of gold.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, whenever a local official in a prefecture, department, or county proved honest, capable, and upright, the court sent an envoy bearing an imperial edict to praise him, raising his rank and bestowing gold.

sentences.zh: 仁、宣之際猶然，英、憲而下日罕。

translations.literal: Under the Hongxi and Xuande emperors this still held; under the Yingzong and Xianzong emperors it grew rare.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Hongxi and Xuande reigns this still held; from the Yingzong and Xianzong reigns onward it grew rare.

sentences.zh: 自後益重內輕外，此風絕矣。

translations.literal: Afterward the court valued the capital over the provinces ever more heavily, and this custom died out entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the court prized the inner administration over the outer provinces ever more heavily, until the custom died out altogether.

sentences.zh: 計天下縣凡一千一百七十有一。

translations.literal: Counties nationwide totaled one thousand one hundred seventy-one.
translations.idiomatic: Counties nationwide numbered one thousand one hundred seventy-one.

sentences.zh: 儒學。

translations.literal: Confucian schools.
translations.idiomatic: Confucian schools.

sentences.zh: 府，教授一人，從九品訓導四人。

translations.literal: At prefectures: one Professor and four Assistant Instructors.
translations.idiomatic: At prefectures: one Professor and four Assistant Instructors.

sentences.zh: 州，學正一人，訓導三人。

translations.literal: At departments: one Director of Studies and three Assistant Instructors.
translations.idiomatic: At departments: one Director of Studies and three Assistant Instructors.

sentences.zh: 縣，教諭一人，訓導二人。

translations.literal: At counties: one Instructor and two Assistant Instructors.
translations.idiomatic: At counties: one Instructor and two Assistant Instructors.

sentences.zh: 教授、學正、教諭，掌教誨所屬生員，訓導佐之。

translations.literal: Professors, Directors of Studies, and Instructors instructed the students under them; Assistant Instructors assisted them.
translations.idiomatic: Professors, Directors of Studies, and Instructors taught the students under their charge; Assistant Instructors assisted.

sentences.zh: 凡生員廩膳、增廣，府學四十人，州學三十人，縣學二十人，附學生無定數。

translations.literal: For stipendiary and expanded-enrollment students, prefectural schools had forty, departmental schools thirty, county schools twenty; supplementary students had no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Stipendiary and expanded-enrollment students numbered forty at prefectural schools, thirty at departmental schools, and twenty at county schools; supplementary students had no fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 儒學官月課士子之藝業而獎勵之。

translations.literal: Confucian school officials monthly examined the students' literary accomplishments and rewarded them.
translations.idiomatic: Each month Confucian school officials examined the students' literary work and rewarded merit.

sentences.zh: 凡學政遵臥碑，咸聽於提學憲臣提調，府聽於府，州聽於州，縣聽於縣。

translations.literal: All educational affairs followed the Sleeping Stele and were directed by the education intendant; prefectural schools answered to the prefecture, departmental schools to the department, and county schools to the county.
translations.idiomatic: All educational affairs followed the Sleeping Stele and were directed by the education intendant; prefectural schools answered to the prefecture, departmental schools to the department, and county schools to the county.

sentences.zh: 其殿最視鄉舉之有無多寡。

translations.literal: Their performance evaluations depended on how many candidates they produced in provincial examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Their merit ratings depended on how many candidates they sent up in provincial examinations.

sentences.zh: 巡檢司。

translations.literal: Inspection posts.
translations.idiomatic: Inspection posts.

sentences.zh: 巡檢、副巡檢，俱從九品主緝捕盜賊，盤詰奸偽。

translations.literal: Inspectors and Deputy Inspectors, both at rank 9b, chiefly pursued bandits and thieves and interrogated suspicious persons.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors and Deputy Inspectors, both at rank 9b, chiefly pursued bandits and thieves and interrogated the suspicious.

sentences.zh: 凡在外各府州縣關津要害處俱設，俾率徭役弓兵警備不虞。

translations.literal: They were established at passes and strategic points outside every prefecture, department, and county, leading corvée archers to guard against the unexpected.
translations.idiomatic: They were established at passes and strategic points throughout the outer prefectures, departments, and counties, leading corvée archers to guard against sudden trouble.

sentences.zh: 初，洪武二年，以廣西地接瑤、僮，始於關隘沖要之處設巡檢司，以警奸盜，後遂增置各處。

translations.literal: At first, in Hongwu year 2, because Guangxi bordered the Yao and Zhuang peoples, inspection posts were first established at critical passes to guard against thieves and bandits; later they were added everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: At first, in Hongwu year 2 (1369), because Guangxi bordered Yao and Zhuang territory, inspection posts were established at critical passes to guard against thieves and bandits; later they were added throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 十三年二月，特賜敕諭之，尋改為雜職。

translations.literal: In the second month of year 13 they were specially granted an imperial admonition; soon afterward they were changed to miscellaneous posts outside the regular ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 13 (1380) they received a special imperial admonition; soon afterward they were reclassified as miscellaneous posts outside the regular ranks.

sentences.zh: 驛。

translations.literal: Courier stations.
translations.idiomatic: Courier stations.

sentences.zh: 驛丞典郵傳迎送之事。

translations.literal: Station Directors managed postal relay and reception and dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Station Directors managed postal relay and the receiving and sending of travelers.

sentences.zh: 凡舟車、夫馬、廩糗、庖饌、裯帳，視使客之品秩，僕夫之多寡，而謹供應之。

translations.literal: Boats, carts, porters, horses, grain rations, kitchens, bedding, and tents were all carefully supplied according to the traveler's rank and the size of his retinue.
translations.idiomatic: Boats, carts, porters, horses, grain rations, kitchens, bedding, and tents were all carefully furnished according to the traveler's rank and the size of his retinue.

sentences.zh: 支直於府若州縣，而籍其出入。

translations.literal: Expenses were drawn from the prefecture or department or county, and income and outgo were registered.
translations.idiomatic: Expenses were drawn from the prefecture, department, or county, and all income and outgo were recorded.

sentences.zh: 巡檢、驛丞，各府州縣有無多寡不同。

translations.literal: Inspection posts and station directors varied in number from place to place among prefectures, departments, and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Inspection posts and station directors varied in number among prefectures, departments, and counties.

sentences.zh: 稅課司。

translations.literal: Tax offices.
translations.idiomatic: Tax offices.

sentences.zh: 府曰司，縣曰局。

translations.literal: At prefectures they were called offices; at counties, bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: At prefectures they were called offices; at counties, bureaus.

sentences.zh: 大使一人，從九品典稅事。

translations.literal: One Grand Commissioner at rank 9b managed tax affairs.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand Commissioner at rank 9b managed tax affairs.

sentences.zh: 凡商賈、僧屠、雜市，皆有常徵，以時榷而輸其直於府若縣。

translations.literal: Merchants, monks, butchers, and miscellaneous markets all paid fixed levies; taxes were collected in season and the proceeds delivered to the prefecture or county.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants, monks, butchers, and miscellaneous markets all paid fixed levies; taxes were collected in season and the proceeds forwarded to the prefecture or county.

sentences.zh: 凡民間貿田宅，必操契券請印，乃得收戶，則徵其直百之三。

translations.literal: Whenever common people traded fields or houses, they had to present deeds for stamping before registration could be accepted; then a levy of three percent of the price was collected.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever common people traded fields or houses, they had to present deeds for official stamping before registration could be accepted; then a levy of three percent of the price was collected.

sentences.zh: 明初，改在京官店為宣課司，府州縣官店為通課司，後改通課司為稅課司、局。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the dynasty, capital official shops were changed to the Revenue Collection Office; prefectural, departmental, and county official shops to the General Revenue Office; later the General Revenue Office was changed to tax offices and bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the dynasty, capital official shops became the Revenue Collection Office; prefectural, departmental, and county official shops became the General Revenue Office; later the General Revenue Office was renamed tax offices and bureaus.

sentences.zh: 倉。

translations.literal: Warehouses.
translations.idiomatic: Warehouses.

sentences.zh: 大使一人，府從九品，州縣未入流副使一人，庫大使一人。

translations.literal: One Grand Commissioner—at prefectures rank 9b; at departments and counties not in the regular ranks—one Deputy Commissioner, and one Storehouse Grand Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand Commissioner—at prefectures rank 9b; at departments and counties outside the regular ranks—one Deputy Commissioner, and one Storehouse Grand Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 州縣設。

translations.literal: Established at departments and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Established at departments and counties.

sentences.zh: 織染雜造局。

translations.literal: Dyeing and miscellaneous manufacture offices.
translations.idiomatic: Dyeing and miscellaneous manufacture offices.

sentences.zh: 大使一人，從九品，州織染局未入流。

translations.literal: One Grand Commissioner at rank 9b; at departmental dyeing offices, outside the regular ranks.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand Commissioner at rank 9b; at departmental dyeing offices, outside the regular ranks.

sentences.zh: 副使一人。

translations.literal: One Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: One Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 河泊所官，掌收魚稅；

translations.literal: River fisheries officials collected the fish tax;
translations.idiomatic: River fisheries officials collected the fish tax;

sentences.zh: 閘官、壩官，掌啟閉蓄泄。

translations.literal: sluice officials and dam officials controlled opening, closing, storage, and release.
translations.idiomatic: sluice officials and dam officials controlled opening, closing, storage, and release.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年，定天下河泊所凡二百五十二。

translations.literal: In Hongwu year 15 river fisheries offices nationwide were fixed at two hundred fifty-two.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu year 15 (1382) river fisheries offices nationwide were fixed at two hundred fifty-two.

sentences.zh: 歲課糧五千石以上至萬石者，設官三人；

translations.literal: Where annual revenue in grain was five thousand shi or more up to ten thousand shi, three officials were established;
translations.idiomatic: Where annual revenue in grain reached five thousand shi or more up to ten thousand shi, three officials were established;

sentences.zh: 千石以上設二人；

translations.literal: where it was one thousand shi or more, two;
translations.idiomatic: where it reached one thousand shi or more, two;

sentences.zh: 三百石以上設一人。

translations.literal: where it was three hundred shi or more, one.
translations.idiomatic: where it reached three hundred shi or more, one.

sentences.zh: 批驗所。

translations.literal: Inspection and verification offices.
translations.idiomatic: Inspection and verification offices.

sentences.zh: 大使一人，副使一人，掌驗茶鹽引。

translations.literal: One Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner verified tea and salt transit permits.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner verified tea and salt transit permits.

sentences.zh: 遞運所。

translations.literal: Relay transport offices.
translations.idiomatic: Relay transport offices.

sentences.zh: 大使一人，副使一人，掌運遞糧物。

translations.literal: One Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner transported relay goods and grain.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner transported relay goods and grain.

sentences.zh: 洪武九年始置。

translations.literal: First established in Hongwu year 9.
translations.idiomatic: First established in Hongwu year 9 (1376).

sentences.zh: 先是，在外多以衛所戍守軍士傳送軍囚，太祖以其有妨練習守禦，乃命兵部增置各處遞運所，以便遞送。

translations.literal: Previously, outside the capital garrison troops of guard units were often used to escort military prisoners; the Founding Emperor, finding this interfered with drill and defense, ordered the Ministry of War to add relay transport offices everywhere to facilitate transport.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, outside the capital garrison troops of guard units were often used to escort military prisoners; the Founding Emperor, finding this interfered with drill and frontier defense, ordered the Ministry of War to add relay transport offices throughout the realm to facilitate transport.

sentences.zh: 設大使、副使各一人，驗夫多寡，設百夫長以領之。

translations.literal: One Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner were established; according to the number of porters, centurions were appointed to command them.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner were established; according to the number of porters, centurions were appointed to command them.

sentences.zh: 後汰副使，革百夫長。

translations.literal: Later the Deputy Commissioner was abolished and the centurions removed.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Deputy Commissioner was abolished and the centurions removed.

sentences.zh: 鐵冶所。

translations.literal: Ironworks.
translations.idiomatic: Ironworks.

sentences.zh: 大使一人，副使一人。

translations.literal: One Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: One Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 洪武七年初置。

translations.literal: First established in Hongwu year 7.
translations.idiomatic: First established in Hongwu year 7 (1374).

sentences.zh: 凡十三所，每所置大使、副使各一人。

translations.literal: Thirteen offices in all; each had one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen offices in all; each had one Grand Commissioner and one Deputy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 初，大使，正八品，副使，正九品，後俱為未入流。

translations.literal: At first the Grand Commissioner was rank 8a and the Deputy Commissioner rank 9a; later both were placed outside the regular ranks.
translations.idiomatic: At first the Grand Commissioner was rank 8a and the Deputy Commissioner rank 9a; later both were placed outside the regular ranks.

sentences.zh: 醫學。

translations.literal: Medical schools.
translations.idiomatic: Medical schools.

sentences.zh: 府，正科一人。

translations.literal: At prefectures: one Chief Physician.
translations.idiomatic: At prefectures: one Chief Physician.

sentences.zh: 從九品州，典科一人。

translations.literal: At departments: one Associate Physician at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: At departments: one Associate Physician at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 縣，訓科一人。

translations.literal: At counties: one Instructor in Medicine.
translations.idiomatic: At counties: one Instructor in Medicine.

sentences.zh: 洪武十七年置，設官不給祿。

translations.literal: Established in Hongwu year 17; posts were created but no salary was provided.
translations.idiomatic: Established in Hongwu year 17 (1384); posts were created but no salary was provided.

sentences.zh: 陰陽學。

translations.literal: Schools of yin-yang.
translations.idiomatic: Schools of yin-yang.

sentences.zh: 府，正術一人。

translations.literal: At prefectures: one Chief Master of Arts.
translations.idiomatic: At prefectures: one Chief Master of Arts.

sentences.zh: 從九品州，典術一人。

translations.literal: At departments: one Associate Master of Arts at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: At departments: one Associate Master of Arts at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 縣，訓術一人。

translations.literal: At counties: one Instructor in Arts.
translations.idiomatic: At counties: one Instructor in Arts.

sentences.zh: 亦洪武十七年置，設官不給祿。

translations.literal: Also established in Hongwu year 17; posts were created but no salary was provided.
translations.idiomatic: Also established in Hongwu year 17; posts were created but no salary was provided.

sentences.zh: 府僧綱司，都綱一人，從九品副都綱一人。

translations.literal: At prefectures the Buddhist Registry Office had one Chief Abbot at rank 9b and one Deputy Chief Abbot.
translations.idiomatic: At prefectures the Buddhist Registry Office had one Chief Abbot at rank 9b and one Deputy Chief Abbot.

sentences.zh: 州僧正司，僧正一人。

translations.literal: At departments the Buddhist Rectory Office had one Abbot.
translations.idiomatic: At departments the Buddhist Rectory Office had one Abbot.

sentences.zh: 縣僧會司，僧會一人。

translations.literal: County Buddhist Association Office, one Buddhist Association Head.
translations.idiomatic: Each county had a Buddhist Association Office with one Buddhist Association Head.

sentences.zh: 府道紀司，都紀一人，從九品副都紀一人。

translations.literal: Prefecture Taoist Registry Office, one Chief Taoist Registrar, one Deputy Chief Taoist Registrar at rank 9b.
translations.idiomatic: Each prefecture had a Taoist Registry Office with one Chief Taoist Registrar and one Deputy Chief Taoist Registrar at rank 9b.

sentences.zh: 州道正司，道正一人。

translations.literal: Department Taoist Rectory Office, one Taoist Director.
translations.idiomatic: Each department had a Taoist Rectory Office with one Taoist Director.

sentences.zh: 縣道會司，道會一人。

translations.literal: County Taoist Association Office, one Taoist Association Head.
translations.idiomatic: Each county had a Taoist Association Office with one Taoist Association Head.

sentences.zh: 俱洪武十五年置，設官不給祿。

translations.literal: All were established in the fifteenth year of Hongwu; officials were appointed but given no salary.
translations.idiomatic: All were established in Hongwu year 15; officials were appointed but received no salary.
